Manage your videos

Updated 15-April-2026

Access to these features require an IMDbPro Premium Subscription. Learn more on the IMDbPro Subscription comparison page.

This article provides answers to the most common questions regarding managing videos with your IMDbPro membership.If you’re unable to find your answer here, simply reach out to a member of our support team by using out contact form.

Ready to get started?

Frequently asked questions

How do I upload a demo reel to my IMDb page?

IMDbPro members can upload demo reels to their IMDb page to showcase their talents and previous work. Please take the following steps to upload your demo reel:

1. Select your name from the main IMDbPro homepage to navigate to your IMDbPro page

2. On your IMDbPro page, go to the Videos tab, click + Add where you will be taken to the video upload page

3. Click Browse and select your video, ensuring it fits within the Recommended Video Settings

4. Add the Video Title and select the Maturity Level of the video

5. Once this required information has been provided, click the yellow “Upload” button to begin uploading your demo reel

It may take up to 24 hours for the video to appear on your page. Your demo reel will be visible on both IMDb and IMDbPro across all devices. IMDbPro members can upload an unlimited number of demo reels to their IMDb page. To edit or remove demo reels you previously uploaded, please go to Your Videos page.

Can I change the video appearing next to my headshot on my page?

The video appearing next to your name is called the Primary video and by default is chosen automatically by a pre-defined logic. As an IMDbPro Premium member, you can select your own primary video to display the content that best represents you and your work. Videos tagged as Mature can’t be used in this slot.

On desktop (IMDbPro.com)

  1. Go to your IMDbPro name page and select the Videos tab to open your Video Gallery.
  2. Add or find the video you’d like to set as your primary video.
  3. Click the Edit dropdown next to that video.
  4. Select Set as primary.
  5. The video you selected will show a “Primary Video” label. Your updated primary video will appear on IMDb sites, apps, and services within 24 hours.

To revert to the IMDb default

If you’d like to to let IMDb choose your primary video again:

  1. In your Video Gallery, find your current primary video (the one with the “Primary Video” label).
  2. Click the Edit dropdown next to that video.
  3. Select Revert primary to default.
  4. The default video will be restored on IMDb sites, apps and services within 24 hours.

On the IMDbPro app

  1. Tap the photo icon in the upper-right corner of the app and choose Your Page.
  2. Select the Videos tab.
  3. Select the Edit videos link on the right-hand side.
  4. On the Edit page panel, select Videos under the Page Sections category.
  5. On the Videos panel, click Primary video and select Use your choice.
  6. Choose the video you want as your primary video.
  7. Select Save to publish the change.

Only IMDbPro Premium members can change their primary video.

Can I remove my demo reel?

Demo reels uploaded from your IMDbPro membership can be removed from the Your Videos page.

This page will show all video content that has been uploaded via your IMDb account. To delete your video, click Delete to the right of the demo reel and click Delete in the pop up window to confirm the change. The video should be removed from your page within 24 hours.

If the demo reel does not appear on the Your Videos page, it means it was added with a previous account and can’t be removed on your end.

For more assistance, please visit our Contact Us page while logged into your IMDbPro account and select IMDbPro member > Claim your IMDb Page (if you are logged out of your IMDbPro account, please select IMDbPro member > Membership Benefits & Pro tips), then select “Email” and let us know how we can help.

For more information on how to get the most of your IMDbPro membership, please see our Pro Tips.

There is an incorrect video assigned to a Title or Name page. How do I report this?

Titles and videos are automatically matched by our software. This is usually accurate in 99% of cases, but mistakes are always possible, particularly when two films have the same (or very similar) titles. If you have found a video linked to the incorrect title/name or a video missing a link to a title/name, please report this to our staff using then following the instructions:

Visit the Contact Us page while logged into your IMDb/IMDbPro account and select IMDb Contributor > I need help and haven’t submitted an update > Images & video > Remove/update videos then select “Email” and let us know how we can help.

What video formats do you accept?

We recommend the following settings to optimize video quality on the IMDb site:

  • File Format: MP4, WMV, AVI or Quicktime
  • Codec: H.264 / AAC, or WMV3 / AAC
  • Resolution: 640x480 for SD, 1280x720 for HD
  • FPS: 30 frames per second
  • Video Bitrate: 2000 kbits/sec for SD 4:3, 5000 kbits/sec for HD
  • Audio: 320 kbps / 44.100 kHz
  • Deinterlacing: On
  • Size: Up to 500 MB
  • Length: 10 minutes or less

Depending on the software you’re using, some of these options may only be available under the “advanced” settings.

These are recommendations - other formats may work. If you have video that has already been compressed to another format, you may want to try uploading it as-is before re-encoding to these formats.

Does IMDbPro allow professional members to post headshots, videos, etc. that have been generated by AI?

While IMDbPro accepts AI-enhanced personal images of professionals (such as those using photo filters), we do not allow fully AI-generated profile photos or AI-generated representations of individuals. This helps maintain trust among industry customers who use IMDbPro for casting and other professional purposes.

Do you support 16:9 / widescreen format? Or do I have to reformat to letterbox 4:3 before uploading?

Both 16:9 and 4:3 formats are supported. For HD video, we suggest the 16:9 widescreen format for the best quality at 720p and 480p.

Note that 16:9 video will be letterboxed when shown in the lower-resolution “standard” view.

Can I upload a trailer/clip and link it to my title instead of just to my IMDb page?

At present, demo reels can only be linked to the IMDb page you have claimed through the IMDbPro membership. Demo reels uploaded by an IMDbPro account will show up as related video on the IMDb page associated with that Pro account.

Someone else already claimed my Name page, can I upload a demo reel to that IMDb page?

Only an IMDbPro membership that has claimed a page may add demo reels to that page. If a representative has claimed your page on your behalf, they will need to upload the video using the IMDbPro membership they used to claim your IMDb page.

What happens to my demo reel if I cancel my membership?

Any demo reels that you’ve uploaded will be removed from the site when you cancel your membership. Note that any videos in which you are tagged (trailers, clips, interviews, etc.) will continue to be displayed on the site even after you’ve cancelled. If you renew your IMDbPro membership in the future, your previously uploaded demo reels will be restored to your page within 24 hours.

For additional info, please see: What happens when I cancel my IMDbPro membership?

My demo reels contain clips from movies. Do I need to get permission from the director?

All uploaded content must comply with the IMDbPro Subscriber Agreement and Copyright Information.

Can I have audio-only demo reels instead of video?

At present, only video demo reels can be uploaded. If you have an audio-only reel such as a voiceover demo, we suggest creating a video clip that uses that reel as the associated audio, and an appropriate title or image as the video.

Setting your vanity URL & other external websites

Access to these features require either an IMDbPro Premium Subscription or an IMDbPro Basic Subscription. See more on the IMDbPro Subscription comparison page.

How do I customize my IMDb URL?

IMDbPro members can select a custom Vanity URL that will redirect users to their page on IMDb. Vanity URLs will have the following format:

www.imdb.me/[VanityURL]

To set your Vanity URL on the desktop version of IMDbPro, please take the following steps:

  1. Go to your IMDbPro page
  2. Under your Credits summary on the Overview tab, click the “Edit vanity URL” button
  3. Enter your Vanity URL and select “Save”

To set your Vanity URL on the IMDbPro mobile app, tap the pencil icon next to External Links on your IMDbPro page Overview tab.

If a vanity URL is showing as taken, you will need to select a different Vanity URL.

If you are waiting for your IMDb page to be created, your Vanity URL will work once your page is live on IMDb.

How do I add or update my X (formerly Twitter) link?

As an IMDbPro member, you can link your X (formerly Twitter) account to your IMDb page.

To add or update your X (formerly Twitter) account, please go to the Vanity URL, X & Blog page, enter your X username in the field and click “Save”

To remove your X (formerly Twitter) account, please delete your X username from the field and click “Save”.

Verified affiliations on IMDbPro

What is verified affiliations on IMDbPro?

IMDbPro empowers entertainment professionals to showcase themselves, their careers, and their affiliations and be discovered by industry decision-makers and fans. Verified affiliations are a way for members on IMDbPro to display their professional affiliations to improve authenticity signals, allowing you to make more informed decisions around connecting with other professionals. Verified affiliations are only displayed when IMDbPro has been able to verify a member’s status with their union, guild, or affiliation.


Verified Australian Writers’ Guild (AWG) member badge

Members are verified directly through Australian Writers’ Guild (AWG). If you are an active AWG member and do not see the verified member badge on your page, contact your guild administrator or contact customer service for further assistance.


Verified Casting Guild of Australia (CGA) member badge

Members are verified directly through the Casting Guild of Australia (CGA). If you are an active CGA member and do not see the verified member badge on your page, contact your guild administrator or contact customer service for further assistance.


Verified Casting Society (CSA) member badge

Members are verified directly through Casting Society (CSA). If you are an active CSA member and do not see the verified member badge on your page, contact your guild administrator or contact customer service for further assistance.


Verified International Casting Directors Association (ICDA) member badge

Members are verified directly through International Casting Directors Association (ICDA). If you are an active ICDA member and do not see the verified member badge on your page, contact your guild administrator or contact customer service for further assistance.


Verified Location Managers Guild International (LMGI) member badge

Members are verified directly through Location Managers Guild International (LMGI). If you are an active LMGI member and do not see the verified member badge on your page, contact your guild administrator or contact customer service for further assistance.


Verified Motion Picture Editors Guild, IATSE Local 700 member badge

Members are verified directly through Motion Picture Editors Guild, IATSE Local 700. If you are an active MPEG member and do not see the verified member badge on your page, contact your guild administrator for further assistance.

Verified National Association of Voice Actors (NAVA) member badge

Members are verified directly through National Association of Voice Actors (NAVA). If you are an active NAVA member and do not see the verified member badge on your page, contact membership@navavoices.org or your administrator for further assistance.


Verified SAG-AFTRA member badge

SAG-AFTRA members can verify their membership details directly on IMDbPro. SAG-AFTRA members can locate instructions and more information on their member app or by logging into sagaftra.org. Once logged in, navigate to the “Membership & Benefits” menu and find the IMDbPro listing on the landing page under “National”.

If you have verified your SAG-AFTRA membership on IMDbPro, and are an active member but do not see the verified member badge on your page, contact customer service for further assistance.

The use of the SAG-AFTRA logo represents current active SAG-AFTRA membership, but is not indicative of work clearance. Continued use of the SAG-AFTRA logo on a performer’s IMDbPro or IMDb name page is contingent on the performer remaining an active SAG-AFTRA member.

  • ##: #### Frequently asked questions
I am an active SAG-AFTRA member. Why should I verify my status?

IMDbPro Basic and Premium subscription customers can verify their SAG-AFTRA membership on IMDbPro, so anyone searching for you or viewing your IMDbPro or IMDb name page, including fans and casting directors, will see a verified SAG-AFTRA member badge. IMDbPro Premium members can also discover you as a verified SAG-AFTRA member using IMDbPro advanced search.

As a SAG-AFTRA member, you will automatically receive your exclusive discount on IMDbPro Premium membership, without manually entering a discount code.

Please note: The SAG-AFTRA member discount cannot be combined with other offers. Terms apply.

As an active SAG-AFTRA member, how can I verify my member status and get a badge on my page?

Verification steps:
You can verify your membership via the SAG-AFTRA member verification landing page, or directly from your name page on IMDbPro.

To verify on the SAG-AFTRA member verification page:

  1. Go to the SAG-AFTRA member verification page and make sure you’re logged into IMDbPro
  2. Input your SAG-AFTRA member ID which can be found on your SAG-AFTRA ID card or on your SAG-AFTRA member portal
  3. Input the e-mail address that matches your SAG-AFTRA membership which can be found on your SAG-AFTRA member portal
  4. Click Continue and your verified affiliation and discount will be applied to your account

To verify from your name page:

  1. Click the “Edit your page” button at the top of your IMDbPro name page
  2. Select “Performer profile & credentials”
  3. Select “Professional affiliations”
  4. Click the “Link your SAG-AFTRA account” link in the “Verified Affiliations” section
  5. Input the e-mail address that matches your SAG-AFTRA membership which can be found on your SAG-AFTRA member portal
  6. Click Continue and your verified affiliation and discount will be applied to your account

You can access the Professional Affiliations edit panel directly here as well.

Upon verification, you will automatically receive your SAG-AFTRA verified badge on your claimed IMDb and IMDbPro name pages. The SAG-AFTRA discount will be automatically applied to your next payment cycle. If you have verified your SAG-AFTRA membership and are an active member but do not see the verified member badge on your page, contact customer service for further assistance.

When I enter my SAG-AFTRA membership information I get an error, how can I get help?

If you receive an error message that we are unable to verify the member details provide, please verify the member number and e-mail you entered match your SAG-AFTRA profile and try again. If you have questions about your membership details and status, please contact the SAG-AFTRA Contact Center at (855) 724-2387.

How do I unlink my SAG-AFTRA member ID and e-mail from my IMDbPro account?

You can unlink your accounts directly from your IMDbPro name page.

  1. Navigate back to your name page on IMDbPro
  2. Go to the About tab, click “Edit” next to Performer profile, and click on Professional affiliations in the resume edit panel
  3. Under Verified affiliations, click “Unlink”
  4. You should see a message confirming that you wish to unlink
  5. Click “Unlink account” and you should see a confirmation of unlinking
  6. Go back to the Overview tab on your page, and should not see a Verified affiliations selection with a SAG-AFTRA badge
Verified South African Guild of Actors (SAGA) member badge

Members are verified directly through The South African Guild of Actors (SAGA). If you are an active SAGA member and do not see the verified member badge on your page, contact your guild administrator or contact customer service for further assistance.


Verified Television Academy (TVA) member badge

Members are verified directly through Television Academy (TVA). If you are an active TVA member and do not see the verified member badge on your page, opt in using the Television Academy Verification for IMDbPro, or contact your administrator for further assistance.

Verified Writers Guild of South Africa (WGSA) member badge

Members are verified directly through Writers Guild of South Africa (WGSA). If you are an active WGSA member and do not see the verified member badge on your page, contact your guild administrator or contact customer service for further assistance.


I am an active member in another guild or union. How can I verify my member status and receive a badge on my page?

If your organization is part of the IMDbPro Affiliate Program, please contact your organization administrator to express interest in accessing this feature as we gradually launch the Verified Affiliations experience.

Who is using my name on IMDb?

Updated 13-July-2026

You may have recently found yourself listed on IMDb, that’s great! However, fear not. IMDb is a database, not a social network. So nobody is impersonating you or using your identity online. Your IMDb Name page has been created so that your work can be recorded on the world’s most popular and authoritative source for movie, TV and celebrity content, designed to help fans explore the world of movies and shows and decide what to watch.

In short, your IMDb Name page was likely derived from your filmography credits being added to titles you’ve worked on. Think of it this way, Alfred Hitchcock has an IMDb Name page (seen below), but died before the modern day internet was invented. As much as we’d like him to, Hitchcock doesn’t manage his own IMDb Name page. But you can!

With that in mind, you can sign up to IMDb and have your very own IMDb user profile. With your IMDb profile, you can contribute or update information across the entirety of IMDb. You can also write reviews, rate titles, create lists and track what you’re watching at the moment.

If you want more control over your IMDb Name page, you can claim it with an IMDbPro Premium (Paid) or Basic (Free) subscription. For more information on how to claim your page, please refer to our guide. Take a look at Which IMDbPro Subscription is right for me? to compare available IMDbPro features for your needs.

You can also find out more information on the difference between an IMDb Name page, an IMDb user profile, and IMDbPro in our Help article.

Still have questions? Check out our Names guide, or reach out to our official IMDb Support Community (powered by Sprinklr).

IMDbPro: Membership Benefits

Does an IMDbPro membership offer additional contribution benefits?

As an IMDbPro member, you are able to contribute and review contact/rep data and in development/in production title data. This data can be only contributed and accessed by IMDbPro members.

IMDbPro does not guarantee data submissions will be accepted or processed at a quicker rate since most submissions are now processed within 24 hours, 7 days per week. Please see our processing times page for more information.

Share profiles with the IMDbPro Card

What is the IMDbPro Card?

As an IMDbPro member you can use this feature to share your profile and promote yourself on social media. Use the card to showcase your profile image, professions, STARmeter rank and Known For titles. You can also share any other person’s profile and with the latest update, you can create an IMDbPro card using the IMDbPro app or the desktop and mobile versions of IMDbPro. Learn more about the IMDbPro app

How can I share an IMDbPro Card?

Visit your page or any other person’s page on www.imdbpro.com or via the IMDbPro app. On the top-right, click on the “Create IMDbPro card” link. The card can be downloaded and shared in social media sites (such as Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, etc.) or emails. We also provide a link to the profile page, anyone using the link can access the IMDbPro profile page.

What options can I select?

  • Profession: “Show all”, “Primary”, “Latest”, “None”.
  • Background: “Light / IMDbPro”, “Dark / IMDb”.
  • STARmeter: “All time high”, “Current” or “None”.
  • Size: “Vertical”, “Square”.
  • Save image: By clicking the “Create IMDbPro card” button, you can save a .PNG image of the card.

IMDbPro: Mobile Web & Apps

Can I add images and edit my page on the mobile site?

At this time the IMDbPro mobile site does not support uploading images or editing additional information. To upload images and edit additional information via IMDbPro while on your mobile device, navigate to the desktop site, by selecting “View Desktop Version” located at the bottom of the page.

Can I change the default experience to the desktop site on my mobile device?

While logged into IMDbPro, there is a link to view the desktop version. If you click “View Desktop Version”, you will be able to view the full desktop site on your device. To return to the mobile site, click the mobile site link at the bottom of the desktop site.

Did you know you can also download the IMDbPro app? Learn more about the IMDbPro app.

Can I edit my IMDb page using IMDbPro on a mobile browser?

At this time, the IMDbPro mobile site does not fully support the ability to edit your IMDb page. Using the IMDbPro app, you can submit updates to your images, Performer Profile, Known For titles, and Filmography.

To submit updates to your IMDb page while using a mobile browser, tap on your photo in the upper-right corner, then select “View Desktop Version” at the bottom of the screen. On the desktop version, you can submit updates by selecting “Edit your page” located at the top of the page.

How do I navigate the IMDbPro mobile site?

The IMDbPro mobile site design is based on the IMDbPro app:

  • Use the navigation bar near the top of the page to find industry news, trending pages, and box office rankings
  • Use the search bar to find specific IMDbPro name, title, and company pages
  • Tap your photo in the upper-right corner for links to your page and the Casting Notices section

For links to log out or view the desktop version of IMDbPro, tap the photo in the upper-right corner.

Did you know you can also download the IMDbPro app? Learn more about the IMDbPro app

Not a member yet?

How is the IMDbPro mobile site different than the desktop version?

The layout for the IMDbPro mobile site is based on the IMDbPro app - optimized for touch navigation, faster load times, and easy access to IMDbPro features.

The mobile site supports many of the same pages and features that the desktop version offers, but there are cases where information or functionality found on the desktop version is not available on the mobile site. Key functionality that is not supported includes editing a page, updating photos, managing your account information, posting casting notices, and creating casting breakdowns. To perform these functions, tap your photo in the upper-right corner and select “View Desktop Site”. Alternatively, you can download the IMDbPro app to edit your page using a mobile device.

How to find contact information on the mobile site?

To view contact information for a person, navigate to that individual’s IMDbPro page and click the Contacts tab below the person’s headshot. To view contact information for a company, navigate to the company page on IMDbPro and click the “Branch Offices” tab.

Did you know?
Download the IMDbPro app for iOS and Android. For further details on the app, please see the IMDbPro App FAQ.

I forgot my password. How do I login?

When you join IMDbPro, you’ll be prompted to select a password. Unless you’ve changed the password since you joined, you can log into IMDbPro using your registered email and password.

The only case when you might not have been prompted to choose a password while joining, is if you were already registered with IMDb.com. In this case, your existing IMDb.com account information (email address and password) was used by default. This lets you access both sites without the need for two separate accounts.

If you were not prompted to choose a password or don’t remember the password for your membership, you can get a new one. To reset your password:

  1. Go to the Log in page.
  2. Select Log in with IMDb.
  3. Select Forgot Your Password.
  4. When prompted, enter the email address or mobile phone number associated with your account and select Continue.
  5. Enter the OTP you received and select Continue.
  6. Create a new password.

As soon as you’ve created a new password, it’s active.

IMDbPro App FAQ

Updated 20-August-2025

Access to the IMDbPro app requires an IMDbPro Standard Subscription. Learn more on the IMDbPro Subscription comparison page.

Frequently asked questions

Which devices and operating systems can download the IMDbPro app?

Current members using iOS 17.0+ or later can download the IMDbPro app from the App Store.

Android devices running Android OS 11 or later can download the IMDbPro app from the Google Play Store.

The IMDbPro app is optimized for use on both smartphones and iPad/Android tablet devices.

Download the app today to get the most out of your IMDbPro membership!

What is included in the IMDbPro app at this time?

The IMDbPro app currently includes the ability to:

  • Check filmographies & credits by accessing profile pages – including access to STARmeter and MOVIEmeter information
  • Find industry contacts & talent representation
  • Claim your name page and submit new cast credits
  • Track people and titles and get notified when they’re in the news
  • Find your next role using our Casting Notices tool
  • Update your profile information and manage your Known For titles
  • Add photos straight from your device to your page
  • Watch trailers, demo reels and IMDb Originals

Can I create/manage/cancel my account from the app?

Using the IMDbPro app for Android, you can use the “Join with Amazon” button to begin the sign up process. You cannot sign up via the iOS app or manage your IMDbPro account from either app at this time. To manage your account please login to IMDbPro from your desktop computer and select “Account Settings”.

How can I find a page using the IMDbPro app?

To find an individual, title, or company page using the IMDbPro app, you can use the search field located on the homepage or open a new search page by selecting the search icon in the app footer.

As you fill in the search bar, the top results for people, titles and companies will appear below. You can then tap “See all results for” to show the top 100 results for your search term. From this page, you can also filter by People, Titles and Companies, then “Refine” to narrow your results.

How do I filter Filmmaker and Filmography lists?

Use the “Refine” button on name and title pages to help you sort through longer lists of credits. Navigate to the Filmmaker or Filmography tab, then tap Refine in the upper-right corner. On the page that opens select the desired professions, then tap “Apply” to see the new list of filtered results.

Can I search by Top STAR/MOVIE/COMPANYMeter?

Results are ordered by relevance as opposed to our popularity rankings, but you can see the top 100 results for each category by tapping Search with an empty search bar. You can also filter a specific search by People, Titles, or Company and use “Refine” to narrow down to a specific popularity range.

How can I see the Image gallery on the IMDbPro app?

To see the image gallery, go to the Photos or Images tab on Name and Title pages. This will bring you to the overview of the image gallery and you can tap the Image thumbnails to view the full image. You can also navigate to your image gallery slideshow by selecting your image in the upper right corner of the page, and using the arrows or swipe to navigate left and right.

Can I upload/delete images and edit my additional information from the IMDbPro app?

You can upload new images to your page and select these as the primary image if desired by navigating to the “Photos” tab on your page. We currently do not support image delete in the app - please reach out to our customer service team if you require an image to be deleted. Additionally, using the “Edit” link found on your page you can submit updates to your additional information.

How do I set my Primary and Featured Images using the IMDbPro app?

In order to manage your Primary and Featured Images, you can either tap on your Primary Image and then “Select new primary image” or navigate to the “Photos” tab and tap on the “Edit photos” button. To replace an image, tap on the slot and then the image you would like to place in this location. To adjust the order of your Featured Images, you can drag and drop your images in the “Featured” section. Once finished making changes, tap “Apply” to save your changes.

Where do I find Job Notices? How do I apply to a role?

To find the Jobs section, tap on the Profile icon in the bottom right of the nav bar, then tap on the Jobs link. Tap on any project title or role for more information, including submission deadline, audition location, start date and filming location. You can also tap “Refine” to filter Jobs based on production type and your personal details. Once you find the perfect role, tap “Apply Now” to begin the submission process. Please note: you must first claim your page using the desktop version of IMDbPro before applying to roles in Jobs.

How do I edit my Known For titles with the IMDbPro app?

From your page, select the “Edit” pen next to Known for to open the Edit Known For page. Here, you can choose to let IMDb decide the titles or tap “Use your choices” to edit the titles that are displayed. You should first tap on an open slot, then tap the title that you would like displayed in that location. If you want to remove a title from your Known For, tap the title and then tap the “X” that appears below. You can also drag titles in the Known For section to adjust their order.

What is my Network and how can I use it?

You can use the “Network” tab on an individual’s IMDbPro page to discover new industry connections based on the titles you have worked on and the people you have in common with your colleagues. When you visit the name page of a person with whom you have shared credits, you can scroll down to the “Network” section, which will display the number of titles and people in common you share with this person. Tapping on the links here will bring you to the “Network” tab with more details, which you can also find at the end of the navigation bar on an individual’s page.

Where can I find Box Office data?

Box Office provides data from Box Office Mojo, the industry’s most trusted box-office reporting service - just go to the Home page, then tap on the “Industry Updates” tab, then navigate down to the Box Office char for the top 5 box office movies for the past weekend. To see full box office data, tap on “See all”.

Can I claim a name page using the app?

If you have not claimed a name page yet and want to claim one on the app, navgiate to the Home page and tap “claim your IMDb page” at the top. If your professional name differs from the name you used to register for IMDb, tap the pencil to the right and input the name associated with your page, then tap Search. If you don’t have a page yet, scroll to the bottom of the search results and tap “Create new page” - new pages are processed within 24 hours.

Can I add/edit IMDb data from the IMDbPro app?

You can add/edit data on your page by navigating to your own claimed Name page, then tapping “Edit Page” or the pencil icons beside any of the data you wish to make changes to. Most changes will typically be reflected within 24 hours

How can I find contact information and reach out?

You can find contact information on the page of the person you are trying to reach. In the menu bar, tap “Contacts”. This will open the direct contact and company information we have for that individual.

To place a call, simply tap on a phone number to open your phone’s calling prompt.

To reach out via e-mail, tap on the e-mail address to open your Mail app.

How can I locate news articles using the IMDbPro app?

Trending news will show on the homepage of the app, similar to the homepage on IMDbPro.com.

If you want to expand the news to read the full article, simply tap on the hyperlinked title to view the article on the news source’s website.

Why is the IMDbPro app asking to send me notifications?

From time to time IMDbPro may send you notifications to inform you of new features, updates regarding your account, or notices about developments of note in the entertainment industry that may be relevant to you. You can change your notification settings at any time.

How can I get help from the IMDbPro app?

If you need assistance, please log into IMDbPro from your desktop computer and select “Contact Us” at the bottom of the page. Our Customer Service team will typically respond within 24 hours.

How do I log out of the IMDbPro app?

To log out of the IMDbPro app, please select the photo icon in the upper right corner and tap “Log out”. You will be taken back to the Log in screen.

Where can I find Harassment and Inequality Resources in the app?

Begin by navigating to the “More” tab, then choose “Harassment and Inequality Resources”. This will open a new page with websites and contact information from the most reliable resources to help fight against harassment and inequality in the entertainment industry.

How do I give feedback about the app?

To give feedback, navigate to the “More” tab and choose “Feedback” to activate the feedback screen where you can enter in your feedback, suggestions, or report a bug.

Why is the app crashing?

Please return to the App Store/Google Play Store and download the latest version of the IMDbPro app. If you are using the latest version of the app, you should force-ce-close (“kill”) the app and reopen.

I received a 403 error signing in, what should I do?

Please force-close your IMDbProPro app and reopen; this should allow you to sign in without issue.

If you are still receiving an error message while logging in, please visit the Contact Us page and select IMDbPro member > Sign up to IMDbPro > Log in/Sign up via IMDbPro App then select “Email” and let us know how we can help.

For more information on how to get the most of your IMDbPro membership, please see our Pro Tips.

If you are not a current member, you may sign-up for a free 30-day trial at any time.

IMDbPro App Notifications FAQ

  • How do I turn off push notifications from the IMDbPro app?
  • Can I turn off push notifications for specific pages?
  • I’m not getting any IMDbPro push notifications on my iPhone. How do I turn push notifications on?

How do I turn off push notifications from the IMDbPro app?

To turn off push notifications from the IMDbPro app, navigate to your account page by tapping the bottom right icon of the app, and then select “Notification Settings”. On the Notification Settings page, toggle off the topics you would like to stop receiving push notifications about.

To opt out of push notifications for names and titles you’re tracking (including titles in your filmography), toggle the “Names & titles you track” options.

To opt out of push notifications about yourself, toggle the “Your IMDb page & news about you” options.

Can I turn off push notifications for specific pages?

No, push notifications can’t be turned off for specific pages at this time.

To stop receiving all notifications about news articles via push notifications and in your Notifications Inbox for a specific person/title, you can untrack their page.

I’m not getting any IMDbPro push notifications on my iPhone. How do I turn push notifications on?

To turn on push notifications from the IMDbPro app, navigate to your account page by tapping the bottom right icon of the app, and then select “Notification Settings”. On the Notification Settings page, toggle on each topic you would like to receive push notifications about.

If you previously clicked “Don’t Allow” when setting up IMDbPro app push notifications, or have turned off IMDbPro app notifications via your device settings, you’ll see the message: “Notifications Disabled”. Please visit your device’s notification settings to toggle the “Allow Notifications” option for iOS or the “Block Notifications” option for Android for the IMDbPro app.

Not a member yet?

Is the mobile site available on phones and tablets?

When visiting IMDbPro on your phone, you’ll be defaulted to the mobile version of the site. You can switch between the desktop and mobile version of the site on your phone by tapping your photo in the upper-right corner, then “View Desktop Site”.

When visiting IMDbPro on your tablet, you will be defaulted to the desktop version of the site. To switch to the mobile version, click on the “View Mobile Site” link located at the bottom of each page. The site will then stay in the mobile version until you opt to switch back to the desktop version.

What is the IMDbPro Card?

As an IMDbPro member you can use this feature to share your profile and promote yourself on social media. Use the card to showcase your profile image, professions, STARmeter rank and Known For titles. You can also share any other person’s profile and with the latest update, you can create an IMDbPro card using the IMDbPro app or the desktop and mobile versions of IMDbPro.

How do I create an IMDbPro card via the app?

On your page or the page of an individual you would like to create a card for, tap the “more actions” menu (three horizontal dots) at the top right corner and select “Create IMDbPro card”. Learn more about the IMDbPro app.


What options can I select?

IMDbPro: New Features & Updates

Announcement: New Credit Categories & Professions

Updated 5-November-2025

We are excited to announce 12 new credit categories on IMDb, advancing recognition for essential entertainment professions.

This enhancement reflects our commitment to serving the evolving entertainment industry and acknowledging the increasingly diverse roles that make today’s content possible.

The new credit categories are:

  • Choreography
  • Color Department
  • Craft Services
  • Health and Safety Department
  • Intimacy Coordination
  • Legal Department
  • Production Department
  • Production Finance and Accounting
  • Property Department
  • Publicity
  • Puppetry
  • Voice Actor - Dubbing

Please see our New Credit Categories{"target=“_blank”} guide for more information.

Previously, these credits were primarily listed under the “Additional Crew” category. Credits are also now displayed under dedicated section headings for these new categories across IMDb and IMDbPro web and apps. IMDb will continue to expand professional credit categories and recognition opportunities based on industry feedback.

The “Voice Actor - Dubbing” credit category is for voice performances (“dubs”) that are translated versions of a title’s originally recorded dialog. We accept dubs into the following languages: English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Portuguese, and Spanish. For more information on how to contribute “Voice Actor - Dubbing” credits, please refer to our guide.

To contribute credits under these new categories, just navigate to the usual credits contribution interface via one of the “Edit”/pencil buttons on a name or title page. You will now see these twelve additional category options listed underneath the pre-existing ones. As before, the “Role” field for each category includes a searchable menu of the most common roles listed under each credit category. For example, the role “production coordinator” is now suggested under the new category “Production Department” (it was previously listed under “Additional Crew”).

Please note that we are also in the process of migrating pre-existing credit items to their relevant new credit category. This will take a number of days, due to the sheer number of credits that we need to move. We expect to complete this migration by Sunday, November 9 at 11:59PM PST.

In addition to new credit categories, IMDbPro Premium members can also select their professions from a recently expanded list of nearly 500 options to enhance their discoverability by industry decision-makers. You will therefore start noticing more specific professions (such as “Production Coordinator” and “Digital Colorist”) directly underneath the person’s name on some name pages across IMDb and IMDbPro.

Please see our New & Updated Professions guide for more information.

As always, we’d love to hear your thoughts, feel free to share your questions and feedback via the IMDb Support Community announcement thread.

— The IMDb Team

IMDbPro Connections Beta (India)

Updated 26-June-2026

What’s new

We are rebuilding IMDbPro Connections from an automatic, title-based system to a two-way approval system. This change will allow customers to connect with any IMDbPro customer, not just ones that they have shared titles with. We are kicking off this new experience with a limited-access beta, giving access to users on a rolling basis until we fully launch the new IMDbPro Connections.

This beta will run on web and mobile web only - this feature is not implemented on IMDbPro apps yet.

Even if you’re in the approved beta, you will not see the new experience in the IMDbPro app. This does mean you may see different IMDbPro Connections data between IMDbPro web and apps during the beta period.

Beta Eligibility

We’re launching Connections in select regions first, starting with India. During this initial phase, members in India can connect with each other — and once the full launch is complete, you’ll be able to connect with members worldwide.

Only customers that are IMDbPro members and have claimed their IMDb Name pages can use the new Connections feature. Customers in the beta who’ve claimed their IMDb Name page can send and accept Connection requests with other eligible beta customers.

If an approved beta customers visits an IMDb Name page for someone who is not eligible for the beta, not yet in the beta, or has not claimed their IMDb Name page, they will not see the new Connect button, and instead they will see the regular IMDbPro Name page display.

Customers who are in the beta, and would like to opt-out should reach out to us via the Contact Us form.

How it looks

Your Own IMDbPro Name Page: A new display will appear in your IMDbPro Name page’s header section indicating the new experience, showing the number of pending connection requests or prompting you grow your network. We are introducing an updated Connections tab, allowing customers to view and manage their network on IMDbPro. This tab includes sections for:

  • Privacy settings
  • Pending connection requests (with accept and reject options)
  • Current connections (with manage/edit options)
  • New connection recommendations (prioritized by mutual connections and shared titles)
  • Blocked connections (with unblock option)

Customers must have a claimed IMDb Name page to use the Connections feature. This is to ensure verification.

Other People’s IMDbPro Name Pages: The header section of the IMDbPro Name page you’re viewing will display a new primary Connect button if you’re not connected with the claimed page owner. When sending a connection request, you can select from a predefined list of reasons you know the person, which will appear in the pending connection notification they receive. The Connect button displays differently based on the connection state. The number of mutual connections and shared titles will also display in the header section. If the IMDbPro Name page owner cannot be connected with, e.g. due to an unclaimed page, the privacy settings, “block” settings and the Connect button will not appear. The Connections tab on other people’s IMDbPro Name pages will display shared titles and mutual connections using the new system, whereas the old shared titles system (pre-beta) will display “People you may know”.

Inbox: When connection requests are sent/accepted, we will show a notification in the inbox. These notifications will only display for web until apps have implemented the new system.

Privacy Settings: You can control who can send you connection request through the privacy settings in the Connections tab. By default, we will disable the entire Connections feature for any user under the age of 18, verified through both their IMDb or Amazon account age, and any age listed on their claimed IMDbPro Name page. Any customers with a STARmeter between 1 - 50K (this range has been selected based on subjective judgement and can be easily configured), or who have ever reached that range historically, will by default have certain privacy settings turned on to respect the privacy of well-known individuals, unless they manually change their privacy setting. In this case, any Connections requester must have mutual connections, shared titles, same company, or client/rep relationship.

Block: We are introducing a blocking functionality that allows customers to block another user by navigating to their IMDbPro Name page and using the drop-down menu on the Connect button. Blocking prevents the blocked user from sending connection requests to the blocker, removes any existing connection between the two, and prevents both users from appearing in each other’s Frequently Credited With or Connection recommendation features. In the future, we plan to introduce additional features (such as endorsements or messaging), by which time blocked users will not be able to interact with the blocker. Blocking does not hide IMDb Name page information from the blocked user, as we consider such data to be public. Blocking will also not remove Track functionality, which is one-way and non-interactive.

IMDbPro Name Page Refresh

Updated 18-December-2025

Access to these features requires an IMDbPro Premium Subscription. Learn more on the IMDbPro Subscription comparison page.

We are excited to announce the refreshed IMDbPro Name page design for IMDbPro Premium members. The refreshed IMDbPro Name pages offer full data and feature parity with the previous version, with an improved layout that prioritizes the display of information, and features that customers use most. We are continuously updating this experience after carefully reviewing all the feedback we receive.

Here’s what to expect:

  • Feature parity - you will have access to all of the same IMDbPro data on the updated IMDbPro Name pages, including in-development credits, STARmeter rankings, contact data, representation info, and client rosters
  • Streamlined page management - You will have direct access to all your editing tools in-line on your own Name page, including setting professions, uploading primary images, selecting Known For titles, and updating your Resume profile.
  • Improved layouts - we are prioritizing the most-used information and features, such as contact data, client rosters. Credits for TV and Film are now combined into a signle chronological view, with filters.
  • *NEW* Research notes - jot down notes on IMDbPro Name pages - visible only to you - about meetings, talent opportunities to collaborate, and more.
  • Mobile-friendly - you will have full feature parity between desktop and mobile web browsers and you can continue to use the IMDbPro App, which is available for both iOS and Android.
  • More visibility to Connections data - you can see your shared titles and mutual connections with people across IMDbPro.
  • Localized translations - view translated content if you have a non-English language preference set for IMDb.

— The IMDbPro Team

IMDbPro: Your Account

Billing FAQ

Why can’t you charge my card for IMDbPro?

Former IMDbPro member with billing questions

Can I join IMDbPro without a card?

Why can’t you charge my card for IMDbPro?

A charge can be declined for a variety of reasons. Usually, the error message should provide a hint about the nature of the problem. If you’re having trouble submitting your payment information, please review the following reasons your payment may have been declined:

  • A typo in the card number. Try entering your card number again.
  • If your card hasn’t expired, verify that the expiration date matches your card.
  • Your name and billing address match the details on file with your bank.
  • Check with your bank about adjusting daily withdrawal or purchase limits. Payment declines may be due to these limits set by your bank.
  • The three-digit CVV/CVC security code normally found on your card is not supported. If the code is required by the issuing bank, payments may not process successfully.

If the charge is declined, we recommend waiting a few minutes before trying again. Your card may have specific restrictions which cause the transaction to be declined. If you’re still experiencing issues with the charge being declined, we recommend contacting your bank or card provider who can provide further details about the transaction charge.

Note: for members in India, your card might be declined due to local financial regulations. Try signing up for a IMDbPro Basic Subscription or adding a different card. International spending and transactions must be activated.

Former IMDbPro member with billing questions

If you have trouble logging in, need help with the billing of an inactive IMDbPro membership, or have other billing questions, please visit the Contact Us page.

If you would like to renew your IMDbPro membership, please go to the login page and click Log in. Once you’ve logged into your account, click Renew Membership.

For more information on how to get the most of your IMDbPro membership, please see our Pro Tips.

Can I join IMDbPro without a card?

All payments on IMDbPro are securely made through Amazon and your information is protected. A credit or debit card is required to join IMDbPro for security reasons. A valid credit card allows us to verify a customer’s identity and avoid multiple sign-ups for free trial memberships.

If you cancel your membership at anytime during the free trial period, your credit card will not be charged. You’ll still have access to IMDbPro for the duration of your free trial. If you decide to keep your IMDbPro membership, you will be automatically billed for the selected membership level at the end of your trial period.

Discounts for IMDbPro Affiliates

The IMDbPro Affiliate Program is an opportunity for membership-based entertainment organizations, such as guilds and unions, to offer their members exclusive IMDbPro benefits.

If your professional guild offers a discount for IMDbPro (see list below), please visit the members only section of your guild’s website to obtain the discount code for your IMDbPro membership.

For new or returning members: After you receive your discount code, visit the promotional code page to sign-up with your discount.

For existing members with an active membership: After you receive your discount code, apply your discount to your next renewal by entering the code on the account membership page.

How can I join IMDbPro?

To join IMDbPro, you will need to log into an existing Amazon account or create a new Amazon account. For details with linking, please see Linking IMDb and Amazon accounts.

Ready to get started?

Please take the following steps to create your IMDbPro membership:

  1. Visit the IMDbPro sign up page and select “Try IMDbPro for free”

  2. Select the IMDbPro subscription that’s right for you by clicking “Start Free Trial” or “Start Basic Subscription”.

  3. Enter the email address and password for your existing Amazon account and select “Sign in using our secure server”

    When creating an account, a one-time password verification is required.

    The password will be sent to the Amazon email address used upon registration. Please check your email and verify the password as prompted.

    If not received, double-check the email address as listed in the prompt to verify and select the “Resend OTP” option. If you’ve made an error with your email address, please start the process again, entering the correct email address.

    If you do not have an existing Amazon account, select “Create an Amazon.com account”, enter the required information, and select “Create account”


  4. Give IMDb permission to log in with your Amazon account

  5. Enter the email address and password for your existing IMDb account and select “Sign in”

    If you do not have an existing IMDb account, select “Create a new IMDb account”, enter your email address, and select “Create IMDb account”

    1. Select your payment plan and click the “Continue” button:

      1. Individual Annual ($149.99 billed annually)

      2. Individual Monthly ($19.99 billed monthly)

      3. Group Plan Monthly ($79.99 billed monthly, up to 5 members)

        Note: due to local regulations, not all members will be eligible for annual memberships based on current address.

    3. Review and select the payment method for your membership — to switch between existing payment methods from your Amazon account, select “Change” next to the displayed card information and proceed to select your preferred payment method.

      If you do not have any payment methods on your Amazon account or if you need to add a new payment method, select “Add a card”

    4. Once you have confirmed the details displayed under “Payment method” and “Billing address” are correct, select “Continue”.

    5. Review the details listed on the Checkout total and select “Join IMDbPro” to create your membership.

      Your card will not be charged until your free trial ends. Your membership will automatically continue unless you cancel your membership before the end of your free trial period. (NOTE: Group plans are not eligible for a 30-day free trial.)

      If you need further help joining IMDbPro, please visit the Contact Us page and select IMDbPro member > Sign up to IMDbPro > Membership benefits and Pro Tips then select “Email” and let us know how we can help.

      For more information on how to get the most of your IMDbPro membership, please see our Pro Tips.

    1. You will then be taken to our page claim process. Find the listing for your profile, and select “Continue”. If you are not able to find your page from the default list, click on the “Let’s refine your search!” link.

      1. You can refine your search by searching with the following details:

        1. Search with new information: You can use this to search by your credited name and titles which you have been credited for
        2. Search for your IMDb page using a URL: You can use this by inputting the direct URL link to your IMDb page to locate your profile

    3. Review and select the payment method for your membership — to switch between existing payment methods from your Amazon account, select “Change” next to the displayed card information and proceed to select your preferred payment method.

    4. Once you have confirmed the details displayed under “Payment method” and “Billing address” are correct, select “Continue”.

    5. Review the details listed on the Checkout total and select “Submit” to create your membership.

      Your card will not be charged for a Basic Subscription. By joining, you agree to the Subscriber Agreement and acknowledge and agree that IMDbPro may submit a one-time authorization request to your payment method for verification, which may result in a $0 line item appearing on your payment method account. You may end your membership at any time from your account settings.

      If you need further help joining IMDbPro, please visit the Contact Us page and select IMDbPro member > Sign up to IMDbPro > Membership benefits and Pro Tips then select “Email” and let us know how we can help.

      For more information on how to get the most of your IMDbPro membership, please see our Pro Tips.

Ready to get started?

How can I try IMDbPro before paying?

You can join IMDbPro for a 30-day free trial. To create your free trial membership please go to Free Trial Sign up.

Make sure you fill all the required information on the page, and choose your payment plan: Individual Monthly or Individual Annual (NOTE: a group plan membership does not offer a free trial period. Learn more about a group plan at https://pro.imdb.com/groupplan). Please note that even though you are signing up for a free trial, you still have to select a payment plan. You won’t be charged for the duration of your free trial, but this ensures you’re charged for the correct fee when your free trial membership ends.

If you decide you don’t want to continue your membership, you can cancel anytime within the free trial period and you will not be charged. If you wish to remain an IMDbPro member, you won’t have to do anything and you’ll be charged for the selected payment plan at the end of the trial.

Your credit card will not be charged for the duration of your free trial, but is required for security reasons. A valid credit card allows us to verify a user’s identity and avoid multiple sign-ups for free trial memberships. If you cancel your trial, your credit card will not be charged and you’ll still have access until your free trial expires.

How do I apply a promo code when joining IMDbPro?

If you have a promo code, you can create your 30 day free trial on this sign-up page. Please enter the code in the “Promotional Code” field and click “Continue”.

If you forgot to apply the promo code at sign-up, you can always apply it afterwards on the Membership page and it will take effect on your first billing date.

How do I cancel my IMDbPro membership?

How to cancel your IMDbPro membership

To cancel your IMDbPro membership, please visit the Cancel Membership page in the Account Settings section while logged into your IMDbPro membership on your desktop computer. You can also select Cancel located at the bottom of every page while logged into your IMDbPro membership (Note: you cannot manage your IMDbPro account from the IMDbPro app at this time).

On the Cancel Membership page, select “Continue to cancel” to proceed until you reach a page to provide feedback. Then you must select the “Confirm cancellation” button in order to complete the cancellation.

You’ll still be able to access IMDbPro until the end of your membership period.

What happens after leaving IMDbPro?

Please see the article What happens when I cancel or downgrade my IMDbPro membership? which explains what will happen after your IMDbPro membership period ends.

Not ready to cancel but would like to receive a reminder before your IMDbPro membership renews?

Select “Remind me later” on the Cancel Membership page to keep your membership active and receive a reminder email 3 days before your membership renews.

Please note, this only applies to the upcoming renewal after selecting this option; in order to receive a reminder for future renewals, return to the Cancel Membership page to enable the reminder.

If you need help canceling, please visit the Contact Us page and let us know how we can help.

For more information on how to get the most of your IMDbPro membership, please see our Pro Tips.

How do I join a group plan?

Enjoy access to IMDbPro with simplified billing managed by the group plan admin. If you have been invited to an IMDbPro group plan membership, you can join the plan by accepting the email invitation.

Join a IMDbPro Group plan

To join a IMDbPro group plan, you will need to be invited by the group plan admin, and to sign-in using an Amazon account.

  1. Have the plan admin add you to their group plan membership.

  2. You’ll receive an email with a link to join. Open it and click on the Accept button.

    1. If you are already signed into IMDbPro, select Join
    2. If you are not signed into IMDbPro, sign-in using your Amazon credentials and select the Join button.

Leave a IMDbPro Group plan

If you have already joined a IMDbPro group plan and would like to leave the group, you will need to be removed by the group plan admin.

  1. Have the plan admin remove you from their group plan.
  2. Both you and the plan admin will receive a confirmation email notifying the change when you have been removed from the group plan membership.

How do I obtain a receipt for IMDbPro?

You can display and print a receipt by going to the Receipts page within Account Settings.

To print a receipt, select the transaction from the drop-down menu, then select “Print” in the upper-right corner of the page. IMDbPro members subject to VAT will also see a “PDF Invoice” option to view and print an invoice with detailed VAT information for the selected transaction.

You will need to be logged into your IMDbPro membership in order to access your receipts. To log into your IMDbPro account, go to our Log In page. If you have forgotten your password, you can click on the forgot your password link on the login page.

Can I access receipts for my inactive IMDbPro membership?

Yes, in order to access receipts for your inactive IMDbPro membership, please go directly to the Receipts page and log in with the email address and password for your expired IMDbPro membership.

How do I renew my membership?

To renew your IMDbPro membership, you’ll need to link an Amazon.com account. Please see Can I join IMDbPro without linking an Amazon Account? for further details.

Ready to get started?

For Amazon and IMDb accounts that are already linked, please visit the renewal page; under the “Log In” drop-down, select “Login with Amazon”

If you have not yet linked your Amazon and IMDb accounts, please take the following steps to begin the renewal process:

  1. Visit the IMDbPro sign up page; under the “Log In” dropdown, select “Log in with Amazon”

  2. Input the login details for your Amazon account

  3. Give IMDb permission to login with your Amazon account

  4. Input the login details to connect your IMDb account
    *If you have forgotten the password to your IMDb account, you can go to the IMDb Password assistance page to reset your password

  5. Once you’ve linked your accounts, select your payment plan - and select “Continue”

    1. Individual Annual ($149.99 billed annually)
    2. Individual Monthly ($19.99 billed monthly)
    3. Group Plan Monthly ($79.99 billed monthly, up to 5 members)

    Please note, due to local regulations, not all members will be eligible for annual memberships based on current address.

  6. Select the payment method for your membership—to switch between existing payment methods from your Amazon account, select “Change” next to the card information, select your preferred card, and select “Continue”

  7. Review the checkout total for your membership and select “Renew”

If you have a discount, please renew on the promotional code page.

How do I update my Amazon password?

If you’ve forgotten your password for the Amazon account used to login to your IMDbPro membership, please take the following steps:

1. Visit IMDbPro

2. Select “Log In”

3. Select “Log in with Amazon”

4. Select “Forgot your password?”

5. Enter the Amazon email address you used to register for IMDbPro, and the characters shown in the CAPTCHA image

6. Select “Continue”

You’ll receive an email from us with further instructions on how to reset your password. If you don’t see this in your inbox, please check your spam folder.

How do I update my billing address?

To update your billing address, visit the Payment Methods page in the Account Settings.

Click the “Change” button next to your billing address. To add a new billing address, please click “Add a new address”. Fill in the information requested and select “Use this address”. If the correct address is already listed on your account, please select the correct address and click “Use this address”.

Please make sure the billing address you provide matches the address on record for your credit card (this is usually the same address where you receive your monthly credit card statement).

How do I update my credit card?

To find information about which payment methods are accepted on IMDbPro, visit our Payment Methods article.

If you are still seeing an error after updating your payment method, please refer to our Billing FAQ article. For Non-US Members with billing issues, please contact your bank or credit card company to enable foreign purchases in addition to online and recurring transactions.

You can update your card information on the Payment Method page within the IMDbPro Account Settings.

Add Payment Method

Update Preferred Payment Method

Remove Payment Method

Add Payment Method

To add a credit or debit card used to bill your membership, please take the following steps:

1. Go to the Payment Method page and select “change”

2. Under “More Payment Options”, select “Add a card”

3. Input your card information and select “Add your card”. When entering your card number, please be sure to omit any dashes or spaces.

4. Select your billing address and click “Use this address”, or “Add a new address”, then select “Continue”

Update Preferred Payment Method

To choose your preferred payment method, please follow these steps:

1. Go to the Payment Method select “change”

2. Select your preferred payment method from the cards on file

3. Select “Continue”

Remove Payment Method

At this time, payment methods can only be removed via your Amazon Wallet.

To remove a card from your membership, please take the following steps:

1. Go to your Amazon Wallet on Amazon.com

2. Select the card you would like to remove

3. Select “Delete”

You can also update your billing address and membership plan within your Account Settings.

How do I update my email address/password for IMDbPro?

To change your password, please visit the Your Details{target"_blank"=““} section in your IMDbPro Account Settings{target"_blank"=““}.

If you sign in with your Amazon account on IMDbPro, you can manage your IMDb account email address and password in your Amazon account settings.

Please follow the below steps:

  1. In In Your Account on Amazon, visit Login and Security (you may be asked to sign in again).
  2. Next to the account information you’d like to update, select “Edit”.
  3. Follow the on-screen instructions and select “Save Changes”.
  4. After you’ve completed all of your updates, select “Done”.
  • If you’re using your Amazon account on IMDbPro, and have forgotten your password, go to Reset Your Password.
  • When using your Amazon account for IMDbPro, if you decide to delete your Amazon account, your IMDbPro account (and related settings) will be deleted too.

Passwords are case sensitive and should be between 8 and 64 characters with at least one number or other non-alphabetic character.

If you’re signed our of IMDbPro and can’t remember your password, please select the “Password assistance” link on the Sign-in page.

To change the email address for your IMDbPro membership, please visit the Your Details{target"_blank"=““} section in your IMDbPro Account Settings{target"_blank"=““}. The registered email will show on this page. Select “Edit” next to your current email address, and enter the new email address and current password, and then select “Save Changes”.

We’ll send you an email to your new associated email address, as well as your old email address, to confirm the update. You can then sign in to IMDbPro with your new email address.

I changed my password, but the site doesn’t recognize me. How do I sign in to IMDbPro?

If you experience any difficulties signing in, please check your browser’s cookie setting. If your browser is not saving the IMDb cookie, our system won’t be able to recognize you when you sign in. After checking your cookies configuration, please complete the following steps:

  1. Sign out of the site
  2. Please sign in using the email and password registered to your IMDb membership

Doing this will help rewrite the cookie and you should be able to access your IMDbPro membership. A cookie is a piece of text saved in your browser, and includes your IMDbPro sign-in information. This cookie allows our servers to recognize you every time you visit the site. In order to access IMDbPro you must have cookies enabled. Once you have signed in and the cookie is set, you won’t be prompted to sign in each time you visit IMDbPro.

How do I update my IMDbPro account settings?

If you’re using your Amazon account on IMDbPro, you can manage your account settings via Amazon.

  • In Your Account on Amazon, visit Login & Security (you may need to sign in again).
  • Next to the account information you’d like to update, select “Edit”.
  • Follow the on-screen instructions and select “Save Changes”.
  • After you’ve completed all of your updates, select “Done”.

If you’re using your Amazon account on IMDbPro, and have forgotten your password, go to Reset Your Password.

When using your Amazon account for IMDbPro, if you decide to delete your Amazon account, your IMDbPro account (and related settings) will be deleted too.

Otherwise, to update your name, email, or password, please visit the Your Details page in your IMDbPro Account Settings, this will take you to the “Login & Security” page where you can update this information.

You can go to the Personal settings page on IMDb.com to add your date of birth and location to your IMDb profile. We will not display this information on our site, this is only used for identification purposes.

If you are just getting started with your account, see also information about claiming your page or adding credits to your IMDb page.


Not a member yet?

How do I update my IMDbPro email preferences?

As an IMDbPro user, you can subscribe to the following topics on the Email Preferences page in your IMDbPro Account Settings:

  • Tips & Tricks: Learn how to manage your account and use IMDbPro features to get the most out of your membership.
  • IMDbPro Updates & Announcements: Be the first to know when IMDbPro releases new features and improvements
  • Promotions & General Communication: Take advantage of deals and don’t miss valuable communication from IMDbPro
  • Industry News: Learn about the most important industry news of the week

You may still receive emails under the Promotions & General Communication topic after the expiration of your IMDbPro membership, including IMDbPro discount offers for inactive members. For all other topics listed above, you will only receive emails while your IMDbPro membership is active.

To unsubscribe from a single topic via the Email Preferences page:

  1. Uncheck the box to the left of the topic
  2. Select “Save”

To unsubscribe from all topics via the Email Preferences page:

  1. Select “Unsubscribe from all”
  2. Select “Save”

Can I unsubscribe from a single topic via an email I received?

Yes, select the “Unsubscribe” link at the bottom of the email you received. This will unsubscribe you only from the topic which the email falls under. To unsubscribe from additional topics, please log in to your active IMDbPro membership registered to the email address where you received the email to update your Email Preferences.

How do I update my membership plan?

To update your membership plan, please visit the Membership page in the Account Settings section.

You can also update your billing address and payment method.

How is my estimated tax calculated?

Transactions made online for IMDbPro are subject to tax charges as required by applicable laws and regulations. Please note, taxes vary by location.

How much does IMDbPro cost?

We currently offer the following membership options:

    • Individual Monthly: $19.99 (billed monthly)
    • Individual Annual: $149.99 (billed annually, equivalent to only $12.50/month - save 37%!)
    • Group Plan Monthly: $79.99 (billed monthly, up to 5 members)

All amounts are in USD; our membership fees are subject to Sales Tax and VAT. For more information, see What’s included with an IMDbPro Membership.

An IMDbPro Basic Subscription has no monthly cost, but requires verified credits on IMDb. Learn more on the IMDbPro Subscription comparison page.

I didn’t sign up for IMDbPro. Why was I charged?

We take billing inquiries seriously and will be happy to help resolve this issue. If you don’t believe you’ve registered as an IMDbPro member, please contact our Customer Service team with the following information:

  1. the card-holder name (exactly as it appears on the credit card)
  2. the type of card (i.e. Visa, MasterCard, American Express)
  3. the last 4 digits of the card
  4. the expiration date of the card
  5. the zip code of your billing address (where you receive your credit card statement)
  6. the date of the charge
  7. the amount of the charge

To provide this information, please visit the Contact Us page while logged into your IMDbPro account (if you are logged out of your IMDbPro account, please select IMDbPro member > Other IMDbPro member issues > Other Payment issue), then select “Email” and let us know how we can help.

For more information on how to get the most of your IMDbPro membership, please see our Pro Tips.

I tried all your suggestions, but can’t join IMDbPro. What should I do?

If you still can’t join IMDbPro or experienced a problem not covered in our Help Center, please visit the Contact Us page then select “Email” and provide further details on what’s happening, and we’ll do our best to help.

For more information on how to get the most of your IMDbPro membership, please see our Pro Tips.

I’ve forgotten my email address/password. How do I sign in to IMDbPro?

If you sign in with your Amazon account on IMDbPro, you can manage your IMDb account email address and password in your Amazon account settings.

Please follow the below steps:

  1. In Your Account on Amazon, visit Login and Security.
  2. Next to the account information you’d like to update, select “Edit”.
  3. Follow the on-screen instructions and select “Save Changes”.
  4. After you’ve completed all of your updates, select “Done”.
  • If you’re using your Amazon account on IMDbPro, and have forgotten your password, go to Reset Your Password.
  • When using your Amazon account for IMDbPro, if you decide to delete your Amazon account, your IMDbPro account (and related settings) will be deleted too.

When you join IMDbPro, you’ll be prompted to select a password. Unless you’ve changed the password since you joined, you can sign in to IMDbPro using your registered email and password.

If you were not prompted to choose a password or don’t remember the password for your IMDbPro membership, you can get a new one. To reset your password:

  1. Go to the Sign in page.
  2. Select “Sign in with IMDb”.
  3. Select “Password assistance”.
  4. When prompted, enter the email address or mobile phone number associated with your account and select “Continue”.
    1. We’ll send you an email or SMS (depending on the verification method you’ve chosen) containing a One Time Password (OTP), to authenticate your request.
  5. Enter the OTP you received and select “Continue”.
  6. Create a new password.

As soon as you’ve created a new password, it will be active.

Linking IMDb and Amazon accounts

Updated: 1 July 2025

IMDbPro is an Amazon company and all payments for IMDbPro are now through Amazon. This adds security and convenience for our IMDbPro members. Amazon makes it easy, so you don’t have to re-enter your card and billing details when joining or renewing your IMDbPro membership.

Can I join IMDbPro without linking my accounts?


All IMDbPro memberships are created and renewed by linking your free Amazon.com account - you can use your existing Amazon account or create a new one. Please note there isn’t a way to join IMDbPro or renew without linking your Amazon account.

Please see our Help page for details on how to join IMDbPro.

How to link your IMDb and Amazon accounts together


Step by step instructions


  1. Make sure you’re logged into the desired IMDb account
  2. Open up the Linked accounts page from your account settings
  3. Next to the heading for Amazon select Link your Amazon account
  4. You’ll then be prompted to login to Amazon, do so with your Amazon login details
  5. On the following page select Connect it to your Amazon account
  6. Provide your IMDb login details and click Sign-In
  7. You’ll be returned to the Linked accounts page and both accounts will be connected

If you need further help joining IMDbPro, please visit the Contact Us page then select “Email” and let us know how we can help.

For more information on how to get the most of your IMDbPro membership, please see our Pro Tips.

IMDbPro Premium Access - Now Available for Entertainment Professionals in India

We are excited to announce that eligible entertainment professionals in India can receive complimentary one-year access to IMDbPro Premium at no cost.

As an entertainment professional in India with an IMDb name page, you can now get complimentary access to all IMDbPro Premium tier features for 12 months.

Frequently asked questions
What IMDbPro Premium features do I get access to with this offer?

  • Add your credits
