For a full breakdown of what’s included, please refer to What’s included with an IMDbPro membership?

Who is eligible for this complimentary IMDbPro Premium access?

This complimentary access is available to entertainment professionals in India with an IMDb name page.

To qualify, you will need to be a new IMDbPro customer, meeting India-specific eligibility criteria and claim your IMDb name page through the self-service process.

How do I access this offer?

  1. Visit the IMDbPro India landing page.

  2. Register for IMDbPro and claim your page. Learn how to claim your page.

    1. If you don’t have an IMDb name page but have professional credits, please see: How to add yourself to IMDb.

  4. Verify your payment method supports international transactions (no charges will be applied during your complimentary membership period). No charges will be applied.

  5. You have access! Begin building your IMDb name page today.

What does “confirm your payment method supports international transactions” mean, and why is it required?

No charges will be applied during or after your complimentary year. This step simply confirms your card can communicate with our payment system for identity verification purposes only.

IMDbPro processes payments through a US-based system, so your credit card needs to support international transactions. Most major Indian credit cards already do, but some cards may have international transactions disabled by default.

If you’re unsure, you can check with your card issuer or enable international transactions through your bank’s mobile app or website.

How long does my complimentary IMDbPro Premium membership last?

The complimentary membership will be valid for a period of 12 months.

Will I be charged after complimentary access ends?

This is a 12-month free offer with no automatic paid renewal attached to it. For any paid memberships, IMDbPro will proactively reach out to you and not charge your card without explicit user action.

What happens after the access ends?

After your 12-month complimentary period, your IMDbPro Premium membership will not auto-renew and will end. You will no longer be able to access IMDbPro Premium without renewing or upgrading your membership again.

Can I cancel anytime without being charged?

Yes, you will be able to cancel your IMDbPro membership at any time.

What should I do if my payment verification fails?

If your payment verification fails, you can resolve the issue by switching to a different valid payment method.

The name on my credit card is different from the name on my IMDb page. Am I eligible?

To be eligible, you will need to submit additional documentation to verify your identity as the subject of the IMDb name page.

If the name page is being claimed by a representative (such as a manager), you will be asked to clarify your relationship with the individual and provide verification that you have permission to submit content on their behalf.

If you are using a stage name, additional documentation will be required to verify your identity as the person listed on the IMDb name page.

Can I use someone else’s credit card to sign up for the complimentary access?

Yes, however, we will require additional documentation to verify your identity as the subject of the IMDb name page.

What should I do if my page claim is denied?

If your page claim has been denied, you will need to submit additional documentation to verify your identity as the subject of the IMDb name page.

All submitted documents must display the same name as it appears on the IMDb name page. The following forms of identification are accepted:

  • A state-issued driver’s license
  • A state or government-issued ID card
  • A passport
  • A birth certificate
I don’t have an existing name page on IMDb to claim. Can I still use this offer?

Having a page on IMDb is an essential criteria for this complimentary access. Please create a name page on IMDb before claiming this offer. You can find instructions on how to do this in our guide: How to add yourself to IMDb.

I’m already an IMDbPro member. How does this affect me?

This complimentary IMDbPro Premium access is available to new members who sign up through the IMDbPro India landing page.

If you already have an IMDbPro Premium membership, this offer won’t change anything on your current account.

You can cancel your existing membership and sign up for the complimentary offer through the IMDbPro India landing page.

However, we’re not able to guarantee a seamless transition between memberships for every account, so we recommend reviewing your current membership details and reaching out to us via the Contact Us form before making any changes, or if you’re unable to access this complimentary 12-month IMDbPro Premium membership.

Use your Amazon account for IMDbPro

Updated 5-June-2026

This article explains how IMDbPro uses Amazon’s account system, and how to sign in to IMDbPro depending on your account type. If you already use “Sign in with Amazon” to access IMDb, keep signing in the same way.

Contents

  • What’s new
  • Why we’re making this update
  • Account management
  • Account sign-in options
  • Related help (quick links)

What’s new

  • IMDbPro uses Amazon’s account system for sign in and new account creation.
What isn’t changing:
  • Your IMDbPro membership continues — your account, IMDb name page, and display settings remain the same.
  • If you have an existing IMDbPro account, you can continue to sign in with IMDb to access your existing IMDbPro account.
  • Existing IMDbPro memberships remain the same. If you used Amazon to sign in to IMDbPro, you’ll continue to use that option. If you used your IMDb email and password to sign in, you will continue to see that option too.

When using your Amazon account to sign in to IMDbPro, if you decide to delete your Amazon account, your IMDbPro account (and related settings) will be deleted too.

Why we’re making this update

  • Consistency: The same sign-in and account across Amazon, IMDb, and IMDbPro.
  • Simplicity: Fewer credentials to manage; you can use your existing Amazon account.

Account management

  • If you are signed in with Amazon on IMDb, manage your account email, mobile number, and password on Amazon (with Two-Step Verification) by visiting the Amazon account settings page: Amazon.com > Account & Lists > Account > Login & security.
  • If you are signed in with IMDb, manage your account email and password by visiting the IMDb account settings page.
  • If you are signed in to IMDb with your Amazon account, deleting your Amazon account also deletes your IMDb and IMDbPro accounts, and all associated data. This includes any active IMDbPro memberships.

Account sign-in options

Depending on your existing IMDbPro membership or sign-in type, you might see messages about account updates or alternative ways to sign in.

  • “Account update”: If your IMDb account is already linked to an Amazon account, your sign-in experience stays the same. Just click “Continue” to sign in with your Amazon account.

What happens when I cancel or downgrade my IMDbPro membership?

When your IMDbPro Premium Subscription ends, the following will no longer be displayed on your IMDb and IMDbPro pages:

    • Images: Featured image customizations and photos uploaded via your IMDbPro membership
    • Demo reels: Primary video customizations and demo reels uploaded via your IMDbPro membership
    • Known for credits: Known For credit customizations will revert to the IMDb algorithm
    • Professions: Profession customizations will revert to the IMDb algorithm

Your IMDb verified credits and filmography will not be affected by your cancellation.

If your IMDb page does not have any verified filmography credits at the time of your cancellation, it will also be removed. If you choose to renew your IMDbPro Premium Subscription membership within 12 months of cancellation, the above information will be restored to your page within 24 hours.

When you end your IMDbPro Basic Subscription, you will not be able to recover the following on your IMDb and IMDbPro pages:

    • IMDb page management: Your IMDb page will no longer be claimed and your connection between your membership and your page will be severed.
    • Page Controls: Any display preferences set via your IMDbPro membership will be removed
    • Self-verified information: Any additional information (including the Personal Details, Performer Profile, and Professional Affiliations) added via your IMDbPro membership
    • Additional Awards and Credits: Any self-verified awards or credits added via your IMDbPro membership
    • Vanity URL: Your set Vanity URL will no longer be functional

What is a group plan membership?

Managing your IMDbPro group plan membership

IMDbPro Group Plans

A group plan membership provides access for five members to receive all the benefits of IMDbPro with the ease of simplified expense reporting that allows the plan admin to enjoy convenient centralized billing with one receipt.

Each group plan member has their own individual IMDbPro account, so there’s no need to share login details. The plan admin can invite or remove members from the group plan, and manage the payment method used for the IMDbPro membership.

To find out more on IMDbPro memberships, please visit “What’s included with an IMDbPro membership?”.

Getting started

When you start a IMDbPro group plan membership, you’ll be the plan admin and are responsible for:

  • The group plan’s monthly membership payment
  • Inviting members to the plan
  • Removing members from the plan

Visit the group plan membership page to sign up!

Do we share an account?

Each member that is invited to the IMDbPro group plan gets their own individual IMDbPro account. And because each member has separate accounts, everybody can manage their own IMDb page and personalize the news notifications they receive.

I’m already an IMDbPro member. What happens to my existing account?

If you already have an individual IMDbPro membership, you can upgrade to a group plan membership with your existing IMDbPro account which will retain all your personalized IMDbPro content and account preferences.

Managing your IMDbPro group plan membership

You must send invitations to members before they can access IMDbPro. Each member of the group will be provided access to personalized IMDbPro content and notifications.

Invite and add members to your group plan:

  1. Go to your Group plan membership settings
  2. Enter the email address of your invitee in the text box, and click Send Invite

Your invited member receives an invitation by email, and must accept the invitation before joining your group plan.

Remove members from your group plan

  1. Go to your Group plan membership settings
  2. a. To revoke an email invite which has not yet been accepted, select Revoke Invite

You can remove members from your group plan at any time. After removing a member, both the subscriber and the removed member will receive an email confirmation.

What is IMDbPro?

IMDbPro is the essential resource for entertainment industry professionals. The membership service includes comprehensive information and tools that are designed to help members of the entertainment industry find success throughout all stages of their career. IMDbPro membership includes tools for professionals to: upload and select their primary image, demo reels and other featured videos; set their primary profession and the credits they are best “known for;” see how they’re connected to other people in the industry based on work history and professional network; use advanced search; view contact information for companies and professionals; build customized lists of titles and talent, and so much more.

Learn about all of the benefits, tools, and services included with an IMDbPro membership.

Ready to get started?

What payment methods are accepted for IMDbPro?

All payments for IMDbPro are made through Amazon and are billed in U.S. Dollars (USD). We accept a variety of payment options, including credit and debit cards. You can safely enter your credit card details via our secure server where your information is protected, which encrypts all submitted information.

We are able to accept the following payment methods:

  • Visa
  • MasterCard / Eurocard
  • American Express
  • Discover Network
  • Amazon Store Card
  • Amazon Secured Card
  • Diner’s Club International (U.S. billing addresses only)
  • JCB
  • NYCE
  • STAR
  • China UnionPay (Credit Card Only)
  • Visa or MasterCard debit cards

For Non-US Members, please ensure the following to work with IMDbPro:

  • International spending and transactions must be activated
  • Authorized for recurring billing
  • Enabled for e-commerce transactions
  • Disabled one-time passwords and multi-factor authentication as these are not supported at this time

Please see more information on how to update your card. If you are still receiving an error with your payment method, please see our Billing FAQ article and contact your card provider or bank for more information.

We’re unable to accept cash, checks, money orders, PayPal, gift cards (including Amazon gift cards), or cards from providers not listed above.

Are you keeping the money charged for sales tax?

How do you know whether to charge sales tax or consumption tax on my transaction, and how much will I be charged?

This is a business purchase, how do I claim a refund of the VAT?

Where can I receive an invoice for my recent transaction including VAT?

Where can I find more information on this?

For more information on how to get the most of your IMDbPro membership, please see our Pro Tips.

Which states in the US are charged Sales Tax & how is it calculated?

An IMDbPro membership is subject to tax in the following US states and US territories:

  • Arizona
  • Connecticut
  • District of Columbia
  • Hawaii
  • Iowa
  • Maryland
  • Mississippi
  • New Jersey
  • New Mexico
  • New York
  • Puerto Rico
  • Rhode Island
  • South Carolina
  • South Dakota
  • Texas
  • Washington
  • Wisconsin

Sales tax is calculated based on the combined state and local tax. Tax is determined based on your billing address listed in the Payment Methods section. To ensure you are charged correctly, please make sure your billing address in the Payment Methods section is up to date.

You can view a breakdown of your charges including the amount of tax you were charged by viewing your Receipts in Account Settings.

If you reside outside of the US, please see more information on VAT charges here.

Why am I told that my email is not valid for IMDbPro?

If you are receiving an error message indicating that your email address is not valid for IMDbPro, you may be registered for two accounts: one for IMDb.com and one pro.IMDb.com. This can happen if you joined IMDbPro and used a different email address to the one you used when you registered for IMDb.com. You will only be able to sign in to IMDbPro with the email address you used when you registered for IMDbPro.

To remedy this, we recommend that you sign in to IMDbPro using the same email address you registered for IMDbPro with. If you remember that email address, but have forgotten your password, please click the “Password assistance” link on the sign-in page to reset your password.

If you have forgotten which email address you used to join IMDbPro, please visit the Contact Us page and complete the form to help us recover your account information.

If creating a new IMDb account for IMDbPro, new accounts are now created with Amazon. For more information, please see our Help article: Using your Amazon account for IMDbPro.

Why did you update my card?

IMDbPro takes precautionary measures to ensure your uploaded images, Featured Image selections, selected Known For titles, and additional information (including Performer Profile & Credentials) added via IMDbPro are not removed from your IMDb page in the event that your preferred payment method is declined.

IMDbPro participates in Account Updater, a service offered by some banks to help keep your cards up-to-date in our system. If your bank participates in Account Updater, this service will automatically update your card number or expiration date in our system when it changes. If you don’t want to have your cards automatically updated, you can opt out of the service by contacting your issuing bank.

If we are unable to complete your order with the payment method associated with your subscription, you authorize us to update your subscription with another payment method you have on file.

If you’ve updated your card information in your Amazon Wallet and selected “Use this card across all Amazon”, this will also update the preferred payment method for your IMDbPro membership.

To update the payment method for your IMDbPro membership, please see: How do I update my credit card?

Why do I need to select a payment plan when joining IMDbPro?

When you join IMDbPro, you’ll need to select between the individual monthly, individual annual, or group plan monthly (for up to 5 members) membership payment plan to ensure you’re charged the correct fee when your free trial ends. Billing is automatic when your free trial ends, when your account is still active. You can always switch your payment plan before the end of the free trial on the Membership settings page.

You can cancel your membership at anytime during the free trial period and your card won’t be charged. You’ll still have access to IMDbPro until the end of your trial.

Please note that a group plan membership for up to 5 members does not offer a free trial period. Learn more about a group plan at: https://pro.imdb.com/groupplan

Why does it say my membership is suspended when I log into IMDbPro?

If you’ve logged into IMDbPro and it says your membership is suspended, it may have been suspended if we couldn’t charge your card for the membership fee.

If your account has been suspended, you just need to provide another credit or debit card and renew your membership.

If you recently paid your membership fee, but are seeing the message that your membership is suspended, you may be logging into a separate membership. To access the paid account, you’ll need to use the same email and password registered to your active membership.

If you have any trouble accessing your active membership, please visit the Contact Us page and let us know how we can help.

For more information on how to get the most of your IMDbPro membership, please see our Pro Tips.

Mobile Web & Apps

Android App FAQ

Updated 10-December-2025

This page provides answers to the most common questions about the IMDb Movies & TV app for Android. If your question isn’t answered here, head on over to the IMDb Support Community powered by Sprinklr, where other customers might be able to help.

Frequently asked questions

What does the IMDb Movies & TV app for Android offer?

The IMDb Movies & TV app for Android gives you access to our catalog of more than 22 million titles and more than 221 million cast and crew members, including celebrities, actors, actresses, and directors. You can watch trailers, exclusive interviews, and IMDb original videos. Look up showtimes near you, buy tickets, and check out critic and user reviews.

Get breaking entertainment news, and follow all of the latest awards and events. Sign in to track what you want to watch on your Watchlist, rate movies and TV shows you’ve seen, check in and share what you’re watching, and set your favorite theaters. Get notified about featured trailers, new movies hitting theaters, the latest entertainment trends, and awards and events news.

How is IMDb for Android different than the regular IMDb website?

The Android version of IMDb have access to all title and name pages. We offer our most popular data items in the app.

You can also sign in to rate movies and TV shows, manage your Watchlist, create and share lists, check in and share what you are watching, and set your favorite theaters.

Where can I download the IMDb app? Is it free?

The IMDb app is free. Visit the Google Play store or Amazon app store on your device and search for “IMDb”. Select and install the application titled “IMDb Movies & TV”.

Is the IMDb app available internationally?

Yes, the IMDb Movies & TV app for Android is available worldwide. App menus are available in English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Korean, Chinese, Japanese, Turkish, and Hindi.

Is there an IMDb app available for iOS or other phone platforms?

We also have an app for iOS. Our mobile site, m.imdb.com, offers a fast way to get just the right amount of information on the go from other mobile devices.

Is an Internet network connection required to use the app?

Yes, the IMDb app requires an Internet connection as IMDb data is retrieved live from IMDb to ensure you’re getting the most up-to-date information.

How do I sign in?

  1. From the home screen, select the profile button in the upper right corner of the screen.

  2. Select “Sign In / Create Account”

  3. Select the option you would like to sign in with (IMDb, Amazon, Google)

Signing in with Amazon links your IMDb account to your Amazon account. To do this, you will be prompted with the screen shown below. Tap “Continue as […]” to use your Amazon account to sign in to IMDb. Please be aware that the option to sign in with your Amazon account may not be immediately available for all users. If you don’t see this option, you can still sign in using your IMDb account.

To learn more about using your Amazon account for IMDb and IMDbPro, please see our Help article.

If you would like to continue to sign in to IMDb with your IMDb account, tap “Not now” or “Sign in to a different account”, and enter the email address associated with your IMDb account.

Why can’t I set my location on the IMDb app?

We currently support device location for countries where we have showtime listing for local theaters.

You’ll be able to select your location for the following countries:

  • Argentina
  • Australia
  • Austria
  • Canada
  • Chile
  • Colombia
  • Germany
  • France
  • Italy
  • Mexico
  • Spain
  • New Zealand
  • Portugal
  • United Kingdom
  • United States

Can I see who looked at my lists/how many people read my lists?

Yes.

To see how many people have viewed and commented on each list, look for the “List Activity” box at the top of the right hand column of the list page.

Can I move the IMDb app to my SD card?

Yes.

You can move the app to your SD card by going to the Settings screen. Click on:

Settings > Applications > Manage Applications > IMDb Movies & TV

Then click on “Move to SD card”.

How do I reset my password on the mobile site?

Please reset your password through the IMDb desktop site.

  1. Go to the Log in page.
  2. Select Log in with IMDb.
  3. Select Forgot Your Password.
  4. When prompted, enter the email address or mobile phone number associated with your account and select Continue.
  5. Enter the OTP you received and select Continue.
  6. Create a new password.

As soon as you’ve created a new password, it’s active.

IMDb App General Troubleshooting

Table of Contents

  • System Requirements for Using the IMDb App
  • Get the Latest App Version for the Best Experience
  • Quick Fixes for Common Problems
  • How to Find Your Device Information

System Requirements for Using the IMDb App

OS OS Version Supported App Versions
Android Android Version 11 or above 9.1.3 or above
iOS iOS 17 or above 14.16 or above
FireOS FireOS 8.0 or above 9.1.3 or above

If your device is unable to meet the above system requirements, you can visit https://www.imdb.com/{target=“_blank”}, which is fully responsive and works well on mobile devices of all screen sizes with no requirements on operating system versions.

Get the Latest App Version for the Best Experience

To check which version of the app you have, open the IMDb app and go to your Profile Tab (furthest right icon on the bottom navigation bar) > Settings (Gear Icon in Upper Right Hand Corner) > App where you’ll find the app version number.

If you want to update to the latest app version for the best experience:

  • For iOS, go to the App Store and search for “IMDb” to upgrade to the latest app version. You can also go to the App Store app and go to your Profile icon in the upper right >> Apps to upgrade your app.
  • For Android, go to the Play Store and search for “IMDb” to see if your device is eligible to upgrade to the latest app version. You can also go to the Play Store app and go to your Profile icon in the upper right >> Manage apps & device >> Updates available to upgrade your app.
  • For FireOS, go to the Amazon App Store and search for “IMDb” to upgrade to the latest app version.

If you are unable to update to the latest IMDb app version or find the latest app version available on the App Store (iOS), Play Store (Android) or Amazon App Store (FireOS), then your device is likely on an operating system (OS) that is no longer compatible with the latest IMDb app version.

Quick Fixes for Common Problems

Most IMDb app issues can be resolved by attempting these troubleshooting steps:

  1. Force close and re-open the app
  2. Log out of your account in the IMDb app, then log back in
  3. Restart your device

How to Find Your Device Information

  • For iOS Devices:

    • Device model & OS version number: On your iOS device, go to Settings > General > About; to the right of Model Name, you’ll see the device model; to the right of Software Version you’ll see the OS version number.
    • IMDb App Version Number:** **On the IMDb app, go to You > Settings > About; to the right of Version you’ll see the IMDb app version number.

  • For Android Devices:

    • Device Model & OS Version Number: On your Android device, go to Settings > About Phone; under the System section, you’ll find Model number; scroll down to find the OS version number.
    • App Version Number: Open the Settings App > Apps & Notifications; go to the list of installed Apps on your device. On the Apps list screen, select the IMDb App to see the Version Number.

  • For FireOS Devices:

    • Device Model & OS Version Number: On your FireOS device, go to Settings > Device Options; under the Device Model or About Fire Tablet section you’ll find your Device Model; scroll to System Updates to find the FireOS version number.

If you’ve confirmed that your mobile device meets the above criteria and have followed the suggested troubleshooting steps, but are still experiencing an issue with the IMDb app, please visit the Contact Us page and let us know how we can help. Please include the following information in your email:

  • Device model
  • OS version number
  • IMDb app version number
  • Description of the issue you’re experiencing, including any steps to reproduce the issue

Visit our other Help pages for more information on the IMDb app for iOS and Android.

IMDb App Notifications

Through our apps (iOS and Android), IMDb offers users the option of receiving push notifications with updates on a number of topics. Get the newest trailers, updates on movie showtimes, learn about IMDb-exclusive content and learn useful tips and tricks for getting the most out of the app.

On iOS, users must opt-into receive notifications on any of the topics they’re interested in; for Android, users are automatically opted-in based on their device preferences.

Android Notifications

You can access the “Notifications” page in one of two ways:

1. From the Home screen, scroll along the tabs (Movies, TV, Celebs, Awards & Events) and select “NOTIFICATIONS”

2. From the User Homepage, tap the three dots next to your name and select “Notifications” from the menu options

From here, you can click “UPDATE NOTIFICATION SETTINGS” and manage which topics you’re subscribed to.

Please note, if you have updated the above settings within the app and are still not receiving notifications (or still receiving unwanted notifications), we recommend checking your device’s notification settings, especially those pertaining to the IMDb app. Some Android devices have an “Always On” default notification setting. To adjust these settings you will need to leave the IMDb app and access the internal device settings, typically represented by a gear icon.

iOS Notifications

You can access the “Notifications” page in one of two ways:

1. Select the “You” tab in the lower right corner, then scroll to the bottom of the page and select “Notifications”

2. From the same tab, select the gear icon in the upper-right corner, then select “Notifications”

From here, you can manage which topics you’re subscribed to.

Please note, if you have updated the above settings within the app and are still not receiving notifications (or still receiving unwanted notifications), we recommend checking your device’s notification settings, especially those pertaining to the IMDb app. You will need to leave the IMDb app and access the internal device settings in the iOS app called “Settings”, represented by a gear icon.

Mobile Site FAQ

Updated 28-July-2025

This page provides answers to the most common questions about the IMDb mobile website. If your question isn’t answered here, head on over to the IMDb Support Community powered by Sprinklr, where other customers might be able to help.

Frequently asked questions

How is m.imdb.com different than the desktop version of IMDb.com?

IMDb’s mobile optimized website gives you access to movie and TV title pages as well celebrity and industry professional pages. We offer our most popular data including: quotes, trivia, plot summaries, synopsis, birth dates and celebrity mini-bios.

You also have quick access to showtimes, trailers, photos, TV network schedules, TV show recaps, box office results, IMDb Top rated movies of all time, IMDb Top rated TV shows of all time, MOVIEmeter (most searched titles on IMDb) and STARmeter (most searched celebrities on IMDb).

What are the device and browser requirements?

The m.imdb.com mobile site will work on any mobile device with a web browser. For an optimal experience, we recommend:

  • iPhone: use your Safari browser
  • Android: use your native WebKit browser
  • Kindle: use your WebKit browser

Is the IMDb mobile website available internationally?

Yes, m.imdb.com is currently available worldwide in English, with other languages coming soon.

Can I log in to my IMDb account on the mobile site?

1. From the home screen, select “Sign In” in the upper right corner

2. Select the option you would like to sign in with (IMDb, Amazon, Google, Apple)

How do I specify my location when using IMDb showtimes via my mobile browser?

By default, your location will be automatically determined when you navigate to the home page or showtimes page, if your device is GPS enabled. The search radius for theaters near you is about 10 miles.

If you don’t see your favorite theater, you can provide your home zip code manually or a zip code in which your favorite theaters reside. To provide a zip code manually:

  1. Navigate to m.imdb.com via your mobile browser
  2. On the IMDb mobile site home page, select “In theaters” in the Explore movies & TV shows section
  3. Under “Near”, select the current location to see the “Set location” settings
  4. Enter your Zip/Postal Code and Country
  5. Select “Update”

What do I need to do if my data doesn’t appear to change over several days?

IMDb’s mobile site saves your most recent page visits on the device for approximately one hour to allow fast loading (such as when accessing “Coming Soon” and “MovieMeter” lists).

If you believe data is stale you can force a refresh by refreshing the page from your mobile browser’s navigation options.

Is there an IMDb app for my mobile platform?

IMDb has developed apps for iOS and Android devices, available in each platform’s app store.

Can I change my default experience to always be the desktop version of IMDb?

No, you may not do so at this time from within a mobile browser. You can switch to the desktop version of IMDb in the footer of each page.

Where can I get help with logging in or with registration problems?

Please see our mobile registration help.

“Mark as watched” FAQ

Updated 28-January-2026

We’re excited to introduce the new Watched feature, an updated version of the former Seen feature. You can now catalog what movies and TV shows you’ve watched by clicking the “Mark as watched” button listed on all title pages, your Watchlist and other lists you’ve generated, as well as Charts like Top 250 Movies and Top 250 TV Shows.

This page provides answers to the most common questions about the new Watched feature, currently available on desktop, mobile web browsers, and the IMDb iOS and Android mobile apps.

— The IMDb Team

On the IMDb iOS app

Frequently asked questions

What is Watched?

Watched is a new feature that enables registered IMDb customers to record what they’ve watched without providing a Rating, Review, or Check-in. IMDb will now also register any movie or TV show you add a Rating to, Review or Check-in as having been watched as well. These movies and TV shows will be listed in a separate “Your watch history” page.

What counts as a Watched action?

Anytime you mark a movie or TV show as Watched, add a Rating, Review, or Check-in.

Can I un-watch a movie or TV show?

Yes, you can unmark a movie or TV show as Watched by clicking the Watched button. However, if you have other activities on the title, such as a Rating, Review, or Check-in, then you will have to remove those activities before unmarking the movie or TV show as Watched.

Where can I find my Watch history?

You can view your Watch history page by clicking your name or found at the top of any IMDb page on desktop and mobile browsers. Select “Your watch history” from the drop-down list to view your Watch history. On Mobile Apps: Tap the “Profile” tab at the bottom of the screen, then tap “More”, and select “Watch history”.

Is my Watch history public?

Your watch history is visible to only you while signed in to your IMDb account.

If I previously used Seen, will titles I’ve marked as “Seen” be automatically backfilled to be marked as “Watched”?

Yes - any title you previously marked as “Seen” has been automatically backfilled to be marked as “Watched”.

Is any functionality being removed with the new Watched feature launch?

Yes, we are deprecating several “Seen” subpages as part of this launch. Also known as the “How much have you seen?” widget found on Name, TV series, and select lists from User Polls, as we update to new technology and design. To provide an interim solution, when trying to access any legacy Seen widgets or URLs (i.e. “How much have you seen?” on Name, TV series, and select lists from User Poll pages) you will be redirected to a filtered Advanced Title Search results page displaying titles you have rated that are tied to a Name or TV series.

We plan to add “Watched” filters to the Advanced Title Search experience as a future enhancement, so you can filter for titles you have marked as “Watched” in your search queries across IMDb’s expansive database.

Can I make my Watch history public?

Not at this time, but we plan to make this functionality available in the future.

Where is this feature available?

You can mark titles as Watched on desktop devices, as well as on mobile browsers and the IMDb iOS and Android mobile apps.

How can I search for all titles I have marked as Watched?

We plan to add Watched filters to the Advanced Title Search experience as a future enhancement, so customers can search and filter for titles they have marked as Watched along with other Title search parameters (e.g. specific Names in Cast or Crew, minimum title rating).

How can I submit feedback or report bugs?

Please add a comment to this IMDb Support Community thread.

Advanced Search Redesign

The updated Advanced Search has three different view types available on each search page tailoring to both written and visual preferences; improved mobile navigation making it easier to view IMDb features on the go; and improved international support, adding to the pages already available in 8 languages.

How do I submit feedback or report bugs?

Please add a comment to this IMDb Support Community thread.

Who is the audience for the new pages?

Everyone, everywhere, all the time! IMDb is built for fans and contributors but we also recognize professionals may have different needs. If this is you, please check out IMDbPro!

What improvements have been made to Advance Search?

It has a modern, clean presentation of information; 3 different view types available on each search page tailoring to both written and visual preferences; improved mobile navigation making it easier to view IMDb features on the go; and improved international support, adding to the pages already available in 8 languages. In addition, the new version has the following new features:

  • The page is responsive across multiple screen sizes, including mobile devices.
  • Accessibility improvements.
  • Search parameters can be edited directly on the page without needing to toggle backwards/forwards as you tune your search results.
  • If you bookmark/favorite your results, the parameters can still be edited to further tune saved queries.
  • The “Page topics” filter enables you to search by plot, quotes, soundtracks, trivia, etc. alongside all other filters to create a more refined search experience.
  • Switching between results views is instantaneous.
  • The “Country” and “Languages” filters include the option to restrict results to the primary country and language.
  • The “Cast or Crew” filter has been improved and includes headshots when available.
  • The “Movie” title type includes documentaries by default for a more inclusive result set (documentaries can still be excluded via the “Genre” filter).
  • Results pagination has been improved and now supports lengthy lists on the same page, removing the restriction to groups of 50/100/250.
  • The “Keywords” filter supports multiple keywords.
  • The “Release date” filter includes a proper calendar for improved date navigation and specification.

What can I do with the (i) (information) icon?

The “i” (information) icon within allows you to see additional information about that Title. Selecting the icon will display a dialog box containing:

  • A plot description.
  • The IMDb rating and an option to give your rating.
  • The director and top three cast members
  • Buttons to play a trailer, if available, as well as the ability to quickly add the Title to your watchlist.
  • Quick-links to all the watch options.

Do I need to update my bookmarks for cast/crew/search?

Yes, if your bookmark includes a param for “roles=” then you need to update it to “role=”. The new modernized search will support both single and multi-selections with “role=”.

Does the newly designed page work on all devices and browsers?

The newly designed page is mobile responsive to work on devices of all sizes and types (e.g. your laptop, tablet, and smartphone), and is compatible with most common operating systems and modern web browsers, such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Opera, and Edge.

However, Internet Explorer (IE) is no longer supported. For maximum compatibility and performance, make sure your browser is up-to-date. If you’re having issues displaying IMDb on your browser, please visit our Help page: Why is IMDb displaying differently on my browser?

When will other pages switch to the new technology and new design?

Currently, our main pages are already modernized on IMDb (e.g. Title, Name, Homepage, Charts, etc) with plans to eventually modernize the rest of the site. Our next focus is on List-Like pages.

Can I exclude documentaries and/or shorts?

Yes, documentaries can still be excluded via the “Genre” filter. The “Movie” title type automatically includes documentaries by default for a more inclusive result set, so to remove select “Genre” and then under “Exclude” select “Documentary” and/or “Shorts”.

You can also exclude any genre from your search by manually modifying the search URL. Inputting an exclamation mark (!) before the genre in the URL will exclude that genre from the search. For example *“https://www.imdb.com/search/title/?genres=!animation{target=”_blank”}“* will exclude any Animation titles from your search. Multiple genres can also be excluded from your search by separating the genres in the URL with a comma (,). Each genre must have the explanation mark ahead of it in the URL in order to exclude it from the search.

How do I search for Quotes, Plot, or with other terms?

Topic search allows you to identify titles or people based on terms associated with their pages, within different data types. To use topic search open “Page topics” in “Search filters” and add your refiners. More information is available in the Using the Advanced Search feature Help page.

Closed Captions and Subtitles

Closed captions and subtitles are available for IMDb Original series, including Supercuts, Fan Q&As, IMDbrief and exclusive on-the-ground or virtual event coverage.

Closed captions are ON when supported videos play on mute and will display in English. Captions using your language of preference will be available in 2023.

You can manage your closed caption settings by tapping or clicking the video and following the on-screen prompts or selecting the captions/subtitles icon in the lower-right of the video. The following settings are available:

  • Subtitle and captions: Off, On when muted, or Always on
  • Caption language: English
  • Font size

Note: On iOS and Android apps, you can change subtitle display preference through your device accessibility settings.

Contribution Interface Updates

Updated 2-October-2025

We’re excited to announce several improvements to our contribution interface that will make submitting credits easier and more consistent.

What’s New:

* Improved Attribute Selection

We’ve replaced the free-text box with a pop-up featuring tick-boxes for valid attribute options, making selection clearer and more straightforward.

* Renamed Field

We have renamed the “Occupation” field to “Role”. We think this is a better description of what is meant to go in it - the role the person had on the title.

* Standardized Crew Credit Fields

All crew credit categories now have both “Role” and “Attribute” fields, making the submission process more consistent. Previously, some credit categories had both an “Occupation” and “Attribute” field, while others only had an “Attribute” field.

* Enhanced Role Section

The Role drop-down menus now feature carefully curated options that are relevant to each credit category. Previously, this menu contained automatically generated options, many of which contradicted our policies - leading to poor quality and ineligible data.

* Dedicated “Self” Category

You can now submit “self” credits under a dedicated “Self” category, with no more need to use the “Actor/Actress” categories with “Self” or “Themselves” prefixes.

These updates are now live in the contribution interface. We hope these changes will make your contribution experience more efficient and user-friendly.

As always, we appreciate your valuable contributions to IMDb! If you have any feedback, please respond to the IMDb Support Community announcement thread.

— The IMDb Website Team

Emoji Reactions on Video

We are excited to launch our new Emoji Reactions feature which customers can use to express their opinion on video content on desktop, mobile web, and our iOS & Android Apps.

We hope you enjoy these latest improvements, and thank you for continuing to make IMDb the world’s most trusted source for movie, TV, and entertainment content.

— The IMDb website team

Frequently asked questions

How do I add a reaction?

You must be signed into your IMDb account to add a reaction to a video. If you attempt to add while signed out, you will be prompted to sign in or create an account.

What reactions can I add?

Each customer can add a thumbs up or down and up to 5 emojis on video content.

Why are only two reactions displaying on a video?

We surface the top two most selected reactions from the community in the summary view for each video. Once you add your own emojis, your most recent two selections will show in the summary to you going forward.

Why can’t I see the count of thumbs down reactions in the reactions summary?

Thumbs down can be used to express sentiment, but at this time summary count is kept private. Reactions added, do not currently influence or affect the video content users see in video recommendations across IMDb platforms.

Will I be able to react to other content on IMDb?

Currently emoji reactions are only available on video content & features. We are looking for new areas and content types to roll this feature out to in the future. Stay tuned!

How do I submit feedback or report bugs?

Please add a comment to

this IMDb Support Community thread.

IMDb Community Guidelines

Updated 4-December-2025

Welcome to the IMDb community! Your new profile is one of millions of fans, contributors, and professionals on IMDb. Our Community Guidelines (terms) are designed to maintain a fun, safe, and healthy environment for all.

Please take note of and follow the below Community Guidelines. These are applicable to all content featured on IMDb profiles, including; images, bios, and usernames.

  • No profane, obscene, disparaging content or harassment. This includes content that promotes, incites or glorifies hatred or racial, sexual or religious intolerance, or promotes organizations with such views
  • No personal or identifying information (PII) of any kind (e.g. phone numbers, emails, physical addresses)
  • No external URLs/links, including obfuscated links
  • No promotional, advertisement, or spam (e.g. personal/professional websites, illegal streaming or deceptive content)
  • No impersonation of any person or entity of any kind (e.g. including “IMDb” in usernames or profile images)
  • No nude or sexually explicit images/content
  • No non-English language in the “Your Profile” bio
  • Respect everyone’s privacy
  • Be kind, courteous, and inclusive to all

IMDb users can report specific content on IMDb user profiles, such as an IMDb user’s profile image, bio, or username that appears to be in violation of our Community Guidelines.

For specific instructions on how to do this, please see How do I report IMDb user profile content?

IMDb reserves the right to remove any content considered to be in violation of our Community Guidelines or wider Conditions of Use. IMDb reserves the right to remove any copyrighted images or content.

For more information, please refer to the IMDb Conditions of Use.

We may amend any of these terms at our sole discretion by posting the revised terms here. Your continued use of IMDb after the effective date of the revised terms constitutes your acceptance of the terms.

IMDb Labs

Updated 23-July-2026

Overview

IMDb Labs is a space on IMDb where you can try early features before they’re fully developed, and help us decide what to add to IMDb next. Each feature in IMDb Labs is an experiment: a working prototype the IMDb team is developing. You can try experiments, vote on the ones you like, and leave feedback for the team behind each one.

As these are experiments, things may break or change. An experiment can be added, updated, or removed at any time. “Labs” is the name of the feature area, not a separate product.

To explore IMDb Labs, go to imdb.com/labs in your web browser and sign in to your IMDb account.

  • How to access IMDb Labs
  • Trying an experiment
  • Voting on an experiment
  • Leaving feedback
  • Browsing by category
  • Signing in to IMDb Labs
  • What’s in IMDb Labs right now
  • Frequently asked questions
How to access IMDb Labs
  • Go to imdb.com/labs in a web browser on any device.
  • Sign in to your IMDb account.
  • Browse the gallery of experiments (featured experiments appear at the top).
  • Select any experiment card to open its detail page and learn more.

Sign in to your IMDb account to browse and use Labs. Visit “Signing in to Labs” below for more detail.

Trying an experiment
  • From the IMDb Labs home page, select an experiment card, or select “Try it” to open it.
  • The experiment opens in your browser. Use the toolbar at the top to navigate, open feedback, or return to the home page.
  • Select the “Labs” logo at any time to return to the Labs home page.

If an experiment won’t load, it may briefly be inactive. Try again later, or return to IMDb Labs to explore others.

Voting on an experiment

Your votes tell us which experiments you’d like to become a part of IMDb.

  • Open an experiment, or find its card in the gallery.
  • Select the thumbs up (like) or thumbs down (dislike) control.
  • You can change your vote at any time.

Try an experiment first, then you can vote on it. If voting isn’t showing, open the experiment and use it before voting.

Leaving feedback

Many experiments include a short feedback prompt so you can tell the team what you think.

  • Open an experiment.
  • Select “Open feedback” in the toolbar.
  • Answer the questions shown, or leave a comment, then submit.

Your feedback goes directly to the team building that experiment and helps them decide what we build next.

(Feedback provided by you is appreciated, but is not a guarantee of any action being taken by our teams).

Browsing by category

Experiments are sorted into groups so you can find what interests you. These categories can change as we add new experiments.

  • Games & Trivia: hands-on games, quizzes, and trivia tests.
  • Discovery & Recs: tools that help you find what to watch.
  • Social & Sharing: ways to share picks with others.
  • Browse & Explore: ways to browse titles and track what you’re watching.

To filter, use the group controls at the top of the Labs home page. Select “All” to view everything.

Signing in to IMDb Labs

Sign in to your IMDb account to use IMDb Labs. Signing in lets you:

  • Browse the full gallery of experiments.
  • Try experiments.
  • Vote on experiments.
  • Save your progress and have it sync with features like your Watchlist and ratings.

To sign in, select “Sign in to join IMDb Labs” from the Labs home page, or “Sign in to try it” on an experiment.

What’s in IMDb Labs right now

The list of experiments changes over time. Here’s what’s currently open:

Experiment Description
Rate-O-Rama Swipe through titles to rate what you’ve seen and build your ultimate watchlist!
IMDb News 2.0 News evolved.
The Shelves Explore the Top 250 in an immersive 3D environment.
Import Your Watch History Transfer your watch history to IMDb from TV Time or almost any other tracker.
Popcorn IQ A quiz that tests how well you know movies, shows, and stars.
Series Guide Sorts the TV shows on your Watchlist by what’s ready to watch, coming soon, or all caught up, with streaming info and next episodes.
Rating Roulette A head-to-head game. Guess which of two movies has the higher IMDb rating.
Reel It In A daily movie-guessing game. Identify the film from a blurred poster, with new clues after each guess.
Get the Picture Guess films from production stills. Harder stills are worth more points.
Give Me Credit Sort a star’s biggest movies into release order before the clock runs out.
Clear the Set A tile puzzle. Sort tiles into the columns where they belong.
Channel 3 Arcade A retro arcade of movie and TV themed mini-games.
Seasonal Anime Tracker Browse anime by season and year and track what you’re watching.
Watch Challenge Take on themed watching tests and track your progress.
Watch This Recommend a title to someone with a personal note and a shareable card.
Time Machine Pick a decade and find out what was popular then.
Mood Explorer Find something to watch using tone and mood filters.
Location Scout Pick a place and find movies filmed or set there.
This or That Answer quick preference questions to get tailored picks.
Star Gaze A playful look at your favorite stars.

Can’t find an experiment you tried before? It may have finished its run or been removed. Check the FAQ below.

Frequently asked questions
What is an “experiment” in IMDb Labs?

An experiment is an early, unfinished feature the IMDb team is testing. It may change, break, or be removed as we learn from your feedback.

Why did an experiment disappear?

Experiments don’t last forever. We add, update, and retire them based on feedback and results. Some may graduate into IMDb, while others may be retired.

Do I need an IMDb account to use Labs?

Yes. Sign in to your IMDb account to browse and try the experiments in Labs, vote, leave feedback, and save your progress.

An experiment won’t load. What do I do?

Experiments can briefly be inactive, please try again later. If the problem continues, return to Labs and explore other experiments.

How do I share feedback or ideas?

Use the “Open feedback” option within any experiment to send your thoughts directly to the team building it.

(Feedback provided by you is appreciated, but is not a guarantee of any action being taken by our teams).

IMDb Name Page Redesign

Updated 25-November-2022

English | Français | Deutsch | हिन्दी | Italiano | Português | Español

We are excited to announce the launch of IMDb’s redesigned Name pages! These pages are meant to make your IMDb experience easier and more enjoyable by providing better access to photos and videos, an upgraded view of an individual’s credits, and improved mobile navigation making it easier to view IMDb features on the go. These enhancements reflect changes suggested by IMDb customers, as well as our own in-depth research designed to enhance entertainment content, discovery, and navigation.

We hope you enjoy these latest improvements, and thank you for continuing to make IMDb the world’s most trusted source for movie, TV, and entertainment content.

Frequently asked questions

Who is the audience for the new pages?

Everyone, everywhere, all the time! IMDb is built for fans and contributors but we also recognize professionals may have different needs. If this is you, please check out IMDbPro!

What is new about this page?

It has a modern, clean presentation of information which works for casual users yet has improved controls and filters for expert users. We’ve restructured information making it easier to read, better access photos and videos, simplified access to a person’s career, and more.

Top page highlights are listed below:

  • A powerful credits section allowing for deeper insights. To name a few opportunities: (1) a simple overview of the most relevant information for each credit (2) Posters for easier visual identification (which are localized where available), (3) direct in-page access to sort by type of project with better support for music videos and audio-podcast types (along with future new types), (4) access to theatrical showtimes, streaming options, TV broadcast and DVD availability for each credit, (5) access to the trailer, genres, running time, plot outline and ratings certificate for each credit, and (6) the ability to add your rating to each credit.
  • Improved international support, adding to the pages already available in 8 languages.
  • Just like on Title pages, you can now easily add a person to a list or create a new list.
  • Instant access to all a person’s secondary page topics and career information searches with the “All topics” menu at the top of the page.
How do I easily see all credits at once?

By default, the Credits section is loaded with filters applied for jobs that the person is most known for. In order to see a person’s entire list of credits, de-select all of the applied filters. Filters can be de-selected by clicking the ones that are selected under the Credits section header. You can then open all the job sections by selecting Expand below.

Additionally, on the All Topics menu we added a link to the text view of credits which is now labeled All Credits for easier access.

How do I use the filter button?

In order to see different slices of a person’s credits, IMDb offers advanced filtering capabilities. In order to access these capabilities, you can click on the blue filter button directly below the Credits section header. This will bring up a dialog box where you will be able to:

  • Change how the credits are grouped: The “Sort by” section is defaulted to “Year.” It groups credits chronologically into upcoming and/or previous projects by year. You can select “Project type” to change the grouping by project types, such as Movie, TV show, etc. Additionally, If you don’t want to see Shorts or Documentaries in the “Movie” group, check the appropriate box to exclude them.
  • Filter down to only show credits from selected genres: The “Genres” section allows you to filter the display of credits to specific genres. For example, if you only want to see credits in the Comedy genre, simply select “Comedy” in the genre section. You can select multiple genres. If you make no selection, no filter will be applied and you will see all credits.
  • Quickly navigate to advanced searches: The “See also” section offers quick links to advanced searches of a person’s credits in order to see it ordered by user ratings, votes, or keywords.
Has “Quick Links” become “All topics?”

Yes! To see all related topics about a person, use the “All topics” button at the top of the page. These links will take you to pages with a deeper level of detail on the topic.

What can I do with the (i) (information) icon?

The “i” (information) icon within a credit allows you to see additional information about that Title. Selecting the icon will display a dialog box containing:

  • A plot description.
  • The IMDb rating and an option to give your rating.
  • The person’s specific credit.
  • Buttons to play a trailer, if available, as well as to quickly add the title to your watchlist.
  • Quick-links to all the watch options.
  • When applicable, a link with the number of episodes and year range to open a view of the person’s credits displayed by episode.
How do I see episode credits?

Select the blue link displaying the count of episode credits for a show. Additionally, you can select the (i) icon. A dialog box will appear that contains the same link.

Does the newly designed page work on all devices and browsers?
  • The newly designed page is mobile responsive to work on devices of all sizes and types (e.g. your laptop, tablet, and smartphone), and is compatible with most common operating systems and modern web browsers, such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Opera, and Edge.
  • However, please note that Internet Explorer (IE) is no longer supported. For maximum compatibility and performance, make sure your browser is up-to-date. If you’re having issues displaying IMDb on your browser, please visit our Help page: Why is IMDb displaying differently on my browser?
When will other pages switch to the new technology and new design?

Currently, home/where-to-watch/photos/videos/title are already modernized on IMDb. We plan to modernize subpages next and eventually the rest of the site.

How do I submit feedback or report issues?

To submit feedback, please add a comment to this IMDb Support Community thread

IMDb’s Language Support

Updated 24-March-2026

English | Français | Deutsch | हिन्दी | Italiano | Português | Español

IMDb is the world’s most popular and authoritative source for information on movies, TV shows and celebrities. That’s why we are pleased to support eight additional languages on an expanded number of pages of the IMDb website. This means you’ll see much more information and data in your language of preference on title and name pages.

Some of the information that you see in your preferred language may rely on machine translations.

These will be prefaced with this symbol:

If you have feedback on this new experience, please leave us a comment on the IMDb Support Community announcement.

The team supporting this feature will be reviewing this thread regularly. Thank you!

Frequently asked questions

What languages are supported?

  • French (Canada)
  • French (France)
  • German
  • Hindi
  • Italian
  • Portuguese (Brazil)
  • Spanish (Mexico)
  • Spanish (Spain)

Why are some pages or content not available in my language of preference?

Not all of IMDb is available in the supported languages above, and IMDb is eager to provide language support to our customers as soon as possible.

You may find while navigating the site that parts or whole pages are still in English. When we do not have information in your preferred language, or do not support machine translations yet for some types of information, we will default to English. We hope this provides a balance between providing access to our extensive databsse, and displaying information in your language of choice.

How does IMDb set my language of preference?

You may have noticed IMDb automatically displays content in your language of preference. There are two ways we do this:

  1. We detect your mobile device or browser language settings and it matches one of our newly supported languages (see list above).
  2. If you are signed in to your IMDb account and have previously selected supported languages. (Profile drop-down > Account settings > Site settings).

How do I change my language of preference?

There is a language selector drop-down in the top right corner of the navigation bar. It will display an abbreviated version of the currently selected language when closed.

If you have your browser or device set to one of the newly supported languages:

  • French - FR
  • German - DE
  • Hindi - HI
  • Italian - IT
  • Portuguese - PT
  • Spanish - ES

To change your selection, click on the drop-down and then click on your preferred language. The page will automatically reload.

Changing your preferred language only works on pages that supports the new languages. If the language selector is disabled, try navigating to Home or a Title page. For more information, please view the FAQ: “Why are some pages or content not available in my language of preference?”

What is the difference between “Fully” and “Partially Supported” languages?

Currently, English is the only fully supported language on IMDb. When English is selected, all content is displayed in that language.

Any language other than English is considered partially supported on IMDb. When one of these languages are selected, we will display as much content in that language as possible. We will use machine translations for some types of information where this is supported. However, some content will remain in English. For more information please view the FAQ: “Why are some pages or content not available in my language of preference?“

We are working to expand our language coverage across the site so we can provide the best experience possible. You can help us by becoming a contributor and submitting non-English content.

How do the translated language display settings affect site language?

If you are signed in and have a display language set, we will attempt to make the site language match (as displayed in the language selector).

  • If your display settings match one of the language and region combinations in the language selector, then both the translated display settings and site language will be the same.

  • If your display settings match only the language in the language selector then the site language will be the same and we will choose a region for you:

    • French (France)
    • German (Germany)
    • Hindi (India)
    • Portuguese (Brazil)
    • Spanish (Spain)

  • If your display settings do not match any of the languages in the language selector, then the default language will be English (US).

Changing the language of the site through the language selector will automatically update your language display settings to match. For instance, if you selected French (France) in the language selector, your settings will become “display language: French” and “display country/region: France”.

How do I turn off the machine translations?

You can enable/disable machine translations from your Site Settings via an on/off toggle.

How do I report a bug or translation error?

Please add a comment to our IMDb Support Community announcement.

Interests (New Features & Updates)

Updated 7-October-2025

Interests are dedicated to a genre, sub-genre or language to explore popular and highly rated series, movies, discover the most anticipated releases, watch new trailers, interviews, and IMDb Original Videos. Interests are available on IMDb.com, the IMDb iOS App, and the IMDb Android App.

You can follow your favorite interests on IMDb! Selecting Add to your interests will result it it being displayed within the Your interests sections on Your Profile, on the Search tab, or in the “Your interests” page - found in the drop-down menu after clicking your name near the top right of your screen on IMDb.com.

What interests are available?

Interests are available for a variety of over 200 genres, subgenres, and languages covering movies and TV. We plan to expand to additional Interests in the future so stay tuned!

Find and add your interests

To see a full list of all available Interests, tap on the Search tab in the IMDb app, scroll down to the Popular interests section and tap on Browse all interests, or visit https://www.imdb.com/interests/all/ in your web browser.

Title pages also help you discover Interests. Interests for each title are listed alphabetically on the title page header first by language, then by subgenre and genre, and within the new Related interests widget that appears on every title page on IMDb.

You can also search for any Interest using the Search box at the top of the Search tab in the IMDb app or in the Search box at the top of IMDb.com. We are working to add search capabilities to more regions soon.
